jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Professional Services
jobs.description:
What You'll Do:

As aSenior Project Manager in Avalara's Professional Services organization, you will lead the planning, governance, and end-to-end execution of large, complex, and high-visibility enterprise implementations for Avalara’s Excise platforms (AvaTax for Energy, Returns for Energy, AvaTax for Tobacco and Returns for Tobacco).

At this advanced level, you will manage multi-faceted customer programs involving challenging technical requirements, tight regulatory deadlines, cross-border logistics (US/Canada), and multi-tier third-party delivery ecosystems (including system integrators and delivery partners). You will serve as a trusted advisor to customer executives, foresee and resolve critical escalations with limited management support, drive rigorous scope and risk management, and help mentor project managers across the practice.

#LI-Remote

What Your Responsibilities Will Be:

**Enterprise Program & Project Execution**

* Plan and execute large, strategic, and high-risk customer implementation programs from initial handoff through post-go-live hypercare and final project sign-off.
* Establish comprehensive program governance, including multi-phase project charters, integrated delivery schedules, resource capacity plans, and stakeholder communication matrices.
* Provide strong leadership and direction to multi-disciplinary project teams (Senior Implementation Consultants, Technical Architects, Data Specialists, and Partner Consultants).
* Proactively manage critical path activities, complex ERP dependencies (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle, PDI Enterprise), and customer cutover plans to ensure on-time delivery.

**Proactive Risk Management & Executive Escalation**

* Identify, quantify, and mitigate complex program risks, technical constraints, and organizational bottlenecks before they impact project velocity.
* Take proactive vs. reactive steps to guide and manage enterprise customer expectations, maintaining alignment across executive sponsors, Tax Directors, and IT leadership.
* Serve as the primary escalation point on project health; resolve difficult customer disputes, timeline pushbacks, and priority conflicts with minimal managerial intervention.
* Maintain rigorous scope control and lead commercial change order negotiations when requirements expand beyond the initial SOW.

**Practice Leadership & Operational Excellence**

* Eligible to earn and serve with the distinction of Team Lead, mentoring, coaching, and onboarding Associate PMs and Project Managers
* Champion operational best practices, contribute to the evolution of PSA workflows (Salesforce PSA / CPQ), and optimize revenue recognition and resource utilization reporting.
* Lead post-project retrospectives, translating lessons learned into reusable delivery frameworks, playbooks, and standardized templates.

What You'll Need to be Successful:

**Required**

* Experience: 5+ years of progressive project/program management experience in enterprise SaaS implementations, professional services, or management consulting.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Operations, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Enterprise Delivery Mastery:
* Proven track record of independently leading large, enterprise-grade software implementations from initiation to successful go-live.
* Deep expertise in managing project scope, schedules, multi-stream budgets, risk registers (RAID), and formal change management procedures.
* Advanced proficiency in Professional Services Automation (PSA) and collaboration platforms (e.g., Salesforce PSA, FinancialForce, Jira, Confluence).
* Executive Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills with demonstrated experience presenting to VP- and C-level customer leadership.

**AI Expectations**

AI is deeply embedded in how we work, solve problems, and deliver for our customers. In this role, you will:

* Apply AI Daily: Leverage AI tools and technologies in your daily workflow to materially increase speed, delivery quality, and problem-solving scale.
* Drive Efficiency & Automation: Proactively identify opportunities to automate routine tasks, streamline implementation workflows, and reduce project backlog.
* Leverage Intelligent Insights: Use AI-enabled tools (e.g., Gong AI) to analyze customer interactions, improve call and delivery quality, and prevent recurring issues.
* Learn & Share: Stay curious about emerging AI trends, adopting new capabilities and sharing best practices across the team.
* Operate Responsibly: Ensure all AI usage strictly adheres to security, privacy, and data governance standards.

**Preferred:**

* Domain knowledge in fuel/tobacco/excise tax compliance, energy supply chains, or enterprise ERP ecosystems (SAP, Oracle Cloud, PDI Enterprise).
* Experience managing hybrid delivery models involving external delivery subcontractors and partner ecosystems.

**Pay Range Details**

The base pay range(s) below are provided in compliance with state specific laws. Pay ranges may different in other locations.

Colorado $100,300-$160,500 [annually]

Washington $100,300-$177,200 [annually]

California $100,300-$194,300 [annually]

NYC $110,800-$194,300,300 [annually]

The pay range above is the general base pay range for a successful candidate in the state listed. The successful candidate’s actual salary/wage may be based on various factors, such as geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business consideration

This role is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance, depending onthe terms of the applicable plan and the employee’s role.

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

jobs.description:

Remote

Full-time

The IV&V Project Manager leads independent oversight and assessment activities for complex technology implementation and modernization programs. This role combines traditional project management experience with independent verification and validation (IV&V) responsibilities to evaluate program governance, project controls, risk management, schedule performance, quality management, and overall delivery effectiveness.
  
  
The successful candidate will have prior experience leading technology implementation projects and will leverage that experience to provide objective assessments, actionable recommendations, and executive-level reporting to clients and project stakeholders. This position serves as both an engagement lead and senior analyst, actively performing governance, project management, and program oversight assessments while coordinating team activities and client communications.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Serve as a senior level individual contributor or project manager depending on project.
* Manage the resource allocation process within the functional unit and work cooperatively with senior management to ensure utilization goals.
* Serve as the central point of contact and primary interface for all project related issues.
* Manage client expectations effectively.
* Maintain and provide availability information for all resources.
* Facilitate team design discussions to ensure appropriate solutions are implemented.
* Ensure the project is in compliance with established standards and procedures.
* Ensure all appropriate costs are included in quarterly forecasts.

**Additional Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Lead Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) engagements supporting technology implementation, modernization, digital transformation, and system integration initiatives.
* Plan, coordinate, and execute assessment activities, including document reviews, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and operational reviews.
* Assess project governance, project management effectiveness, risk and issue management, schedule performance, organizational readiness, vendor performance, and implementation progress.
* Analyze project artifacts, performance metrics, and delivery processes to identify risks, gaps, emerging concerns, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop findings, recommendations, executive briefings, assessment reports, and other client-facing deliverables.
* Facilitate communication with project stakeholders, delivery teams, vendors, and executive leadership while providing objective, evidence-based insight.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives, assessment methodologies, and quality standards across the IV&V practice.
* Mentor junior analysts and contribute to business development, proposal, and practice-growth activities as opportunities arise. (This is a recruiting/practice recommendation rather than a solicitation requirement.)
* Bachelor's Degree in related field.
* 5-7 years of relevant professional experience required.
* Equivalent combination of education and experience considered in lieu of degree.

**Additional Skills and Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience leading technology implementation, modernization, system integration, or digital transformation initiatives.
* 2+ years of experience performing IV&V, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Control (QC), PMO governance, project oversight, audit, compliance review, or comparable independent assessment activities.
* Experience evaluating project governance, project management practices, risks, issues, schedules, delivery performance, and implementation readiness.
* Experience developing assessment findings, executive briefings, reports, recommendations, and other client-facing deliverables.
* Strong analytical, written communication, and stakeholder management skills. Based on the governance, reporting, assessment, and oversight responsibilities defined for the role.
* This is a remote position with an expectation of up to 30% travel based on business and client needs. Candidates must be able to accommodate occasional travel as required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise software implementations or modernization programs.
* Experience in consulting, professional services, PMO, project assurance, or advisory environments.
* Experience overseeing third-party vendors, systems integrators, or multi-vendor delivery programs.
* Experience working in public sector, health and human services, child welfare, Medicaid, or other regulated environments.
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, SAFe, hybrid, or traditional project delivery methodologies.
* PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe, CSM, Lean, Six Sigma, or related certifications.

We are seeking a Technical Business Analyst to join our team supporting our Internal Revenue Service (IRS) client.
  
  
This position is remote. Candidates must meet requirements to obtain and maintain an IRS Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) clearance (active IRS Moderate Risk MBI is a plus).
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Develop and maintain effective processes for managing requirements, developing business processes, and providing production support to the operation.
* Lead and implement the design, analysis, interpretation and evaluation of a variety of reports, internal/external resource documents and surveys.
* Lead and own activities related to Business Requirement Documents process.
* Analyze existing systems, programs, policies, and organizational processes and recommend enhancements and improved solutions.
* Design and implement process improvements that enhance customer service and optimize business operational efficiency and quality.
* Conduct statistical analyses and evaluates a wide variety of information to assess operational difficulties and develop solutions to complex problems, including escalated issues Independently develop and implement modeling and evaluation processes to determine the effectiveness of current operational activities.
* Provide oversight and perform research and gap analysis to determine and improve effectiveness of all operational documentation.
* Serve as a liaison between business ops and system team for the planning, implementation and maintenance of programs and contractual changes.
* Communicate status, risks, and issues to the Systems Analysis and Design Director, senior management and/or the client, as appropriate.
* Monitor BA activities with the Systems Analysis and Design Director to ensure that all business analysis activities are allocated appropriately and executed as planned.
* Ensure all business requirements and business processes are adequately documented.
* Lead cooperative efforts among members of a project team.
* Manage efficient execution of business meetings with internal project staff, client staff, and/or project vendors.
* Act as advisor to project team members to resolve problems.
* Provide support to operation senior staff, division managers and program managers.
* Develop high quality communications suitable for clients.
* Work effectively with internal and external business partners in the delivery of solutions.
* Maintain extensive and comprehensive working knowledge of all assigned programs and projects.

**Job-Specific Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Coordinate and engage with technical and business stakeholders to gather requirements, conduct analysis, validate requirements, produce proof of concept, concept of operations, user stories, diagrams, process flows, and other outputs.
* Provide governance support and reporting activities to include coordination of data calls, tracking of tasks and milestones, and communicate status of projects and activities.
* Create, update, and manage high-quality project documentation that meets IRS acceptance criteria, acquisition strategies, use cases, or executive briefings. Create and review reports.
* Develop briefings, presentations, and reports to stakeholder groups and executive audiences.
* Develop and maintain project schedules to allow tracking of performance activities required.
* Work with teams dispersed across geographical sites.
* Foster collaboration and communication between team members on technical issues, on process improvements, and in addressing and escalating project risks and issues.
* Document, manage, and report project risks according to IRS Risk Management process.
* Support and participate in release planning sessions.
* Monitor multiple release schedules and support product managers in ensuring critical actions and milestones are completed.
* Track and monitor complex risks and dependencies across the organization that might impact the successful delivery of multiple projects, including change requests.
* Ensure all tasks are completed in compliance with all IRS security requirements.
* Provide status reports, attend meetings and take/distribute minutes.

**Job-Specific Minimum Requirements:**  

* Proven ability to work on and with many development teams that are dispersed across geographical sites. Experience using online communication tools (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Zoom).
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, technical training or work experience considered in lieu of degree.
* Minimum of seven (7) years of experience with a bachelor’s degree.
* Minimum seven (7) years of working experience working in a project management capacity.
* Knowledge of federal information security policies, standards, procedures, directives, and risk management processes.
* Candidates must meet requirements to obtain and maintain an IRS Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) clearance (active IRS Moderate Risk MBI is a plus).
* Candidates must be a US Citizen or a Legal Permanent Resident (Green Card status) for at least three (3) years, and Federal Tax compliant.
* Bachelor's degree in relevant field of study and 7+ years of relevant professional experience required, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Preferred Skills and Qualifications:**  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Ability to work well independently or in a team setting.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Technician Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Recognized as a “Best Place to Work Modern Healthcare” – Join a team where people come first.** At Vital Care, we are committed to creating an inclusive, growth-focused environment where every voice matters.

Vital Care (www.vitalcare.com) is the premier pharmacy franchise business with franchises serving a wide range of patients, including those with chronic and acute conditions. Since 1986, our passion has been improving the lives of patients and healthcare professionals through locally-owned franchise locations across the United States. We have over 100 franchised Infusion pharmacies and clinics in 35 states, focusing on the underserved and secondary markets. We know infusion services, and we guide owners along the path of launch, growth, and successful business operations.

What we offer:

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, plus flexible spending, and health savings accounts.
* Paid time off, personal days, and company-paid holidays.
* Paid Paternal Leave.
* Volunteerism Days off.
* Income protection programs include company-sponsored basic life insurance and long-term disability insurance, as well as employee-paid voluntary life, accident, critical illness, and short-term disability insurance.
* 401(k) matching and tuition reimbursement.
* Employee assistance programs include mental health, financial and legal.
* Rewards programs offered by our medical carrier.
* Professional development and growth opportunities.
* Employee Referral Program.

***Job Summary:***

The Implementation Manager is a pharmacy technician certified by a nationally accredited pharmacy technician certification program. This position serves as a liaison between the franchise partners and Vital Care Infusion Services to ensure all onboarding tasks meet expectations, are guided by precedent, and work in compliance with established policy. This position also provides ongoing consultative support and educational development services as needed. Support and development activities provided by this position must meet applicable regulatory compliance and industry expectations.

***Duties/Responsibilities:***

* compliance with USP Chapter and USP Chapter regulations and any applicable state Board of Pharmacy regulations related to compounding rooms, devices, supplies, and personnel. This includes supporting new franchisees and approved vendors with ISO classified areas, verifying that recommended products used meet USP requirements for sterile compounding, and supporting the training efforts for new compounding personnel.
* Supports developing and revising facility design resources and sterile compounding training resources for franchise employees.
* Provides consultative support and guidance to new infusion pharmacy franchises in areas related to facility construction, sterile compounding, preparing for and responding to initial regulatory surveys and inspections, vendor management, optimal workflow strategies, new hire orientation, annual training, and other pharmacy operational activities.
* Review current onboarding program standards, resources, and educational programs on an ongoing basis; document and revise them as needed to meet franchise needs and regulatory standards.
* Develops, interacts with, and maintains effective relationships with sterile compounding-related equipment and supply vendors serving the franchise network; supports timely order, delivery, and equipment installation at each franchise location.
* Develops, facilitates, and serves as the Company’s liaison with franchise owners, their construction contractor teams, and Vital Care’s vendors to ensure timely construction project completion.
* Serves as a resource concerning accreditation, pharmacy, and sterile compounding-related regulations and standards.
* Facilitate internal collaboration to ensure key milestones are completed on time and meeting expectations.
* Analyze, review, and report on progress with team members and business partners.
* Complete assigned projects efficiently and effectively based on departmental expectations.
* Follow the established protocol for implementing new franchises while being solution-oriented and resourceful to identify challenges and opportunities proactively throughout the process.
* Facilitate and manage franchises within the company’s project management system.
* Collaborate and delegate critical onboarding tasks to subject matter experts in response to franchise location requests for assistance.
* Engage in consistent and timely follow-up communications with franchise partners using various media platforms (i.e., text, email, Microsoft Teams).
* Communicates and provides reports to leadership as requested.
* Follows and abides by all company policies and procedures.
* Other duties as assigned.

***Required Skills/Abilities:***

* Prior experience in roles involving sterile compounding and infusion pharmacy.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.
* Excellent teaching skills and ability to demonstrate and communicate critical procedures to pharmacy professionals.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to quickly grasp issues and understand strategy and demonstrated ability to work independently and make good business decisions.
* Demonstrated process and project ownership orientation with the ability to manage priorities and meet time commitments.
* Ability to effectively collaborate and communicate project status with onboarding teams and Company leadership.
* Highly skilled communicator in verbal, written, and oral presentation of information.
* Demonstrated analytical, quantitative, and organizational skills, providing the ability to analyze progress, identify trends and anomalies, and recommend needed improvements.
* Solution-oriented and resourceful, demonstrates excellent problem-solving and customer service skills.
* Proficient in MS Office Suite and demonstrated ability to work effectively within Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and other Program Management systems.

***Edu

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Promotional Medical Education
jobs.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a **Senior Project Manager** to join our growing Promotional Medical Education team!

The Senior Project Manager leads the planning, coordination, and delivery of complex client campaigns across one or more accounts. This role keeps teams aligned, manages scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and client approvals, and partners closely with Account, Finance, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality work on time and on budget.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Indianapolis, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. *This role will work Eastern standard business hours.*

**What you’ll do:**

* Own day-to-day project management for assigned campaigns from initiation through closeout, ensuring work is delivered on time, within scope, and within budget
* Build and manage detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, status reports, and resource plans across multiple complex deliverables and teams
* Partner with Account, Finance, internal teams, subcontractors, and client stakeholders to keep work moving and ensure clear communication at every stage
* Monitor budgets weekly, support revenue recognition and invoicing activities, and flag financial risks or scope changes early
* Lead project meetings, manage client review and approval processes, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards and relevant guidelines
* Identify, escalate, and help resolve risks, timeline conflicts, resource constraints, and project issues
* Support business development efforts by contributing project management guidance, budgets, timelines, and implementation planning as needed
* Participate in project audits and help reinforce consistent project management processes and best practices
* Coach, mentor, and train project management team members and contribute to onboarding or discipline-specific training
* Share best practices through the Project Management Community of Practice and contribute to process improvements or standard operating procedures
* Participate in hiring activities for the project management discipline, such as panel interviews or job shadows
* Develop and empower people, manage change, build relationships and influence others, build and lead effective teams, and achieve results

**This position is a perfect fit for you if:**

* Our Company values – *Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always* and *Accountability with an “I”* – really speak to you
* You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving
* You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data
* You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines

**What you should have:**

* 4+ years of project management experience in an agency setting
* 3+ years of experience in budget development/management
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related business experience
* Experience leading multiple cross-functional project teams and deliverable types, as well as successful management of campaign budgets
* Strong Microsoft Office skills and familiarity with structured project management methodology; PMP certification preferred
* Strong communication, organization, leadership, problem-solving, and client-readiness skills
* Prior experience in healthcare or pharmaceutical industry or agency preferred
* Experience in Workfront is highly preferred

  

**Pay Range:** $90,000-$100,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on .

**Job Summary**

The Operational Security Manager provides operational and technical leadership for the delivery of cybersecurity services and security program execution across client organizations, with an emphasis on healthcare and other highly regulated environments.

  

This position is accountable for security service delivery, security resource management, operational risk reduction, vulnerability management governance, incident readiness, policy governance, security operational effectiveness, and the coordination of cybersecurity activities across internal resources, client stakeholders, managed service providers, and third-party partners.

  

The Operational Security Manager serves as the primary technical leader responsible for assigning security resources, establishing security priorities, coordinating security workstreams, and ensuring that cybersecurity initiatives align with organizational risk-management objectives. This role supervises security analysts and engineers and acts as the primary operational security liaison between client leadership, technical teams, governance stakeholders, and security service providers.

  

The Operational Security Manager is accountable for security operations oversight, security resource management, vulnerability management governance, incident response coordination, security service delivery, security program execution, security awareness programs, security risk coordination, policy and standards development, data protection governance support, technical stakeholder communications, and operational security reporting. The position is not accountable for project scheduling, milestone management, portfolio governance, or project-trackability reporting, which remain the responsibility of assigned Project Managers.

  

The Operational Security Manager partners closely with Project Management personnel, who maintain project schedules, milestones, dependencies, and portfolio reporting. While Project Managers own workstream trackability, the Operational Security Manager owns security resource assignments, technical execution oversight, service quality, and operational outcomes. Primary internal partnerships include Project Managers, Security Architects, GRC Analysts, Privacy and Compliance Teams, IT Infrastructure Leadership, Clinical Technology Teams, and Managed Security Service Providers.

  

**Essential Job Functions**

The following duties are normal for this position. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from being expected of this position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment for this position. Other duties may be required.

  

* Lead daily cybersecurity operations across assigned client environments, including monitoring, alert triage, incident response coordination, and operational remediation activities.

* Supervise security analysts, engineers, and specialized security resources; establish priorities and assign resources across security workstreams.

* Manage cybersecurity resource allocation across operational, strategic, and project-related activities, including workload balancing and resource-conflict resolution.

* Support governance, risk, and compliance activities, including assessments, audits, risk analysis, evidence collection, remediation planning, and policy, standard, procedure, and guideline development.

* Oversee managed security service delivery, service quality, operational effectiveness, service maturity, and accountability for assigned security tasks across internal and external resources.

* Coordinate data protection and privacy-related security activities, including DLP, DSPM, data classification, sensitive data protection, investigations, eDiscovery support, and remediation activities.

* Lead security awareness and training initiatives, evaluate program effectiveness, and develop recommendations to improve organizational security culture.

* Monitor third-party and vendor security risks, review material vendor-security findings, provide technical input to vendor risk assessments, and escalate issues that may affect operations or regulatory obligations.

* Provide operational security reporting to leadership and client stakeholders, including updates on security operations, vulnerability management, incident trends, control effectiveness, security-program maturity, and remediation activities.

* Provide technical status, resource constraints, and security-risk updates to Project Management for portfolio-level reporting while maintaining ownership of security-resource assignments, technical execution oversight, service quality, and operational outcomes.

* Oversee the operational effectiveness of security technologies and managed security platforms, including SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, email security, identity security, logging infrastructure, and detection engineering.

**We're transforming the grocery industry**

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

--------------------------------

The Data Analyst position will play a pivotal role on the PEO Analytics team, leveraging operational performance data to diagnose fulfillment quality gaps, spearhead the detection and resolution of quality issues, and deliver data-driven recommendations that improve Instacart's products and processes. This means not only tackling immediate escalations but also establishing proactive monitoring systems that enhance long-term operational excellence, as well as supporting cross-functional insight needs that drive improvements across multiple areas of the business.

 

The Platform Excellence Operations (PEO) team is dedicated to improving the quality of Instacart's online grocery experience for customers, shoppers, retailers, and the overall marketplace. The analytics team identifies, understands, and eliminates defects in that experience by analyzing and interpreting operational data, ensuring stakeholders have a consistent understanding of why business performance is changing and advocating for improvements that might otherwise be overlooked. 

 

As part of the Marketplace and Retailer Pillar within PEO Analytics, this role works on fulfillment quality problems ranging from cancellations and reschedules to timeliness, and plays an essential role in maintaining Instacart's reputation for reliability and operational excellence, from metrics analysis to strategy development. * Retailer performance issues are proactively monitored and resolved across broad dimensions, with dashboards and processes built to simplify problem diagnosis and support new retailer launches.
* Performance fluctuations and outliers in key Retailer Quality workstream metrics are tracked and analyzed to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.

 

**Data Analysis**

* Large datasets related to Retailer Fulfillment Quality are analyzed to derive business insights, with analytical plans independently created and executed to identify, understand, and reduce fulfillment quality issues with high accuracy and consistency.

**Presentations and Communication**

* Insights decks are created and presented regularly to a cross-functional audience of business and technical stakeholders, with findings framed as clear logical narratives backed by data that result in actionable recommendations.

--------------------------------------------

**Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)**

* 1+ years of experience in a data analytics-related role such as business intelligence, corporate strategy, consulting, or data science.
* Experience analyzing and visualizing large datasets.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel or Google Sheets for data analysis.
* Ability to aggregate and synthesize large amounts of data, leveraging a deep understanding of micro and macro fulfillment metrics and systems to drive insights.
* Strong problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail; able to quickly detect anomalies in performance metrics and trends, form hypotheses for investigation, and draw conclusions through nuanced analysis.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint or Google Slides for effective communication.

* Experience working in a consumer marketplace or logistics business.

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will work across a diverse portfolio of enterprise initiatives, which may include technology implementations, business process transformation, operational improvements, data and reporting initiatives, organizational change, and firm-wide strategic projects and programs.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working in a professional services environment and partnering with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.

jobs.title: Project Manager PMO Manufacturing
jobs.description:
At Crestron Electronics, Inc we build the technology that integrates technology.
  
  
We are proud to be the largest and most recognized brand in automation and control solutions, and the premier technology partner for fortune 500 businesses globally. Our products’ are integrated into new high-tech commercial buildings’ to include some of the most exciting real estate throughout the world. Our clients include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, LinkedIn and many others. We are the leaders in the most exciting industry in the world!
  
Our automation and control solutions for homes and buildings allow our clients to control entire environments with the push of a button, integrating systems such as Audio Visual, Lighting, Shading, Security, Building Management Systems and HVAC to provide greater comfort, convenience and security.
  
  
The Manufacturing Project Manager is responsible for the transition of new products from Engineering to Production. This position is responsible for coordinating the operations deliverables to build and test the prototypes, validate the Pilot run and ramp up for mass production. The Manufacturing PM is responsible for coordinating with supply chain, production engineering, test engineering, planning and contract manufacturing.
  
This position is responsible for planning, implementing, monitoring and controlling many simultaneous projects. This position requires good organization and communication skills, both written and oral, to collaborate with cross functional teams of internal and external organizations. The candidate should be able to direct tasks and priorities with minimal supervision. Knowledge of the Electronic Manufacturing, Project Management Process and experience as a Project Manager is a plus. Strong computer skills in MS Project, MS Office (Excel, Work, PowerPoint, Visio) is a plus.
  
The Project Manager is expected to Independently coordinate stakeholders across functions, and maintain strong customer and business awareness throughout program execution.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Create project plans for procurement, prototype builds, production support equipment and mass production for launching new products
* Manage and control projects, measure and communicate progress against the baseline plan
* Identify and document project risks. Develop risk mitigation plans.
* Lead cross-functional teams to meet project deliverables and schedules.
* Lead product reviews and Launch Readiness reviews
* Coordinate the production plans with the supply /demand teams, identify impacted products and plans to transition from the old to new products.
* Coordinate transfers of products to contract manufacturers for mass production
* Support PMO process improvements, reporting enhancements, and cross-functional coordination initiatives.

**Qualifications:**  

* 3- 5 years’ experience in Project Management, ability to lead multiple large-scale projects simultaneously
* 3-5 years’ experience in electronic manufacturing industry
* 3-5 years familiarity with NPI processes and manufacturing readiness coordination.
* 1-3 years’ experience working with contract manufacturers and/or OEM vendors
* 1-3 years’ experience working with supply chain teams to develop long lead mitigation strategies
* 3-5 years’ experience contributing to PMO process improvement initiatives.
* Strong Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office, SharePoint, Power BI skills
* Strong Project Management process skills
* Strong data analysis, problem solving and decision-making skills
* Teamwork, communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience with Jira and best practices knowledge to execute feature releases
* Manufacturing process familiarity
* Electronic and/or Mechanical product knowledge

Per applicable state requirements, the annual pay range for this position ($72,500 - $117,500) which consists of base salary (subject to performance), reflects the hiring range for candidates. Also note, an individual’s offer may vary from this range as it may be impacted by additional factors, including but not limited to the candidate's hiring location, qualifications, experience, and market factors.
  
  
Crestron Electronics offers a competitive total compensation package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, 401K with company match, Paid Time Off, Holidays, On-site Amenities at NJ Headquarters & TX Facilities, Crestron Market Cafes, and Fitness Centers.
  
  
At Crestron Electronics, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion drive innovation. Crestron’s success hinges on continuing to build a workforce of unique individuals whose passion inspires us to create and revolutionize industry-leading products and services. There will always be more to accomplish, and at Crestron, we believe the best way forward is together.

jobs.title: Real Estate Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Title: Real Estate Project Manager**  
**Location: 50 East 168th Street, Bronx, NY 10452**  
**Reports to: Director of Housing and Real Estate**

**About Us:**  
The Women’s Housing and Economic Development Corporation (WHEDco) is a community development organization founded on the radically simple idea that all people deserve to live in healthy, vibrant communities. We build award-winning, sustainable, affordable homes – but our work is not over when our buildings are complete. WHEDco believes that to be successful, affordable housing must be anchored in strong communities of which residents can be proud. WHEDco’s mission is to create and bridge access in the South Bronx to resources that support thriving neighborhoods – from stable, affordable housing to high-quality early childhood and school-age youth education programs, comprehensive family and community services, business and entrepreneur assistance, and cultural programming. See www.whedco.org for more information.

**Job Summary:**

The Project Manager (PM) supports WHEDco’s Housing and Real Estate Department by developing and managing construction projects at WHEDco’s three mixed-use properties from inception to completion. In coordination with the Director of Housing and Real Estate, the PM will identify and address building and programmatic needs, plan and execute capital work, and use financial and operational data to measure impact, in order to ensure long term physical and financial sustainability.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage WHEDco’s capital projects, including new construction and renovations. Assist in securing funding, loan closings, pre-development, design, bidding, contract development, insurance review, budgeting, and construction project management and administration; Coordinate with residents and staff; Assist the Director of Housing and Real Estate with funding requisition processes and overall project tracking and reporting to funding agencies.
* Serve as a point person for all of WHEDco facility maintenance needs and as a liaison among vendors, project teams, property management, residents, and WHEDco staff to ensure timely completion and achievement of project goals.
* Coordinate and lead on-site and virtual project meetings. Maintain communication with consultants, design professionals, contractors, trades, funding agencies, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget; Represent WHEDco in construction meetings led by property management or third-party consultants.
* Manage utilities and energy performance across WHEDco’s three properties. Ensure compliance with local laws, the NYC Building Code, and energy benchmarking requirements; Monitor existing energy retrofit projects, including a combined heat and power (COGEN) system, monitor and manage other energy and water saving programs.
* Manage emergency systems including fire alarm panels, central station monitoring, elevator calling, security, and camera monitoring; Use knowledge of building systems to provide support in the development and maintenance of emergency plans, fire safety plans, as well as business continuity plans for WHEDco’s programs and services.
* Ensure WHEDco’s buildings are compliant with various funding and regulatory agencies; Support property management in monitoring and removing building violations, including ECB/OATH, DOB, FDNY, DOHMH, and HPD, and recommend operational changes to prevent compliance issues.
* Support Asset Manager and Director of Housing and Real Estate in identifying issues impacting residents and WHEDco programs and develop capital plans and budgets to address these; Research, recommend, and implement capital projects that enhance energy efficiency, sustainability, and resiliency in WHEDco buildings; In coordination with the Asset Manager, evaluate returns on investment, and the financial and operational impact of work.
* Engage residents, building maintenance, and WHEDco staff in recycling, waste reduction, and other sustainability practices that can reduce building operating expenses and improve quality of life for building residents and WHEDco clients.
* Support the Asset Manager and Director of Housing and Real Estate with asset management and compliance projects as needed.
* Maintain and organize critical asset documentation, including loan documents, insurance records, building plans, regulatory agreements, and capital project records.
Assist the Director of Housing and Real Estate with additional projects and strategic initiatives as needed.  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in real estate development, property management, urban planning, business, or affordable housing. Master’s degree preferred but not required.
* Minimum of two years of relevant professional experience in real estate, construction, property or facilities management, affordable housing, or a related field preferred.
* Experience working in NYC preferred including familiarity with relevant agencies (e.g., DOB, FDNY, HPD, HDC, HRA) or experience in a role with direct agency coordination, compliance, or reporting.
* Strong organizational skills, with keen attention to detail. Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and documentation is essential.
* Strong project management, financial, and analytical skills.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, for developing and tracking budgets, and evaluation.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proactive problem-solver and avid team player. Must have the ability to remain focused in a fast-paced environment.
* Demonstrated commitment to affordable housing and serving low-income communities.

**This is a full-time, exempt position. Excellent benefits and competitive salary based on experience. This is a hybrid position requiring a minimum of four days per week on-site at WHEDco properties or offices. The regular in-person workdays will be established by the Directo

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------

  
  
  

About the Role

The Aviation Department is responsible for the safe, secure and efficient operation of one of the world’s busiest airport systems, comprised of John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR), LaGuardia Airport (LGA), New York Stewart International Airport (SWF) and Teterboro Airport (TEB). The 10-year Capital Plan has dedicated a record amount of funding for state of good repair projects across the portfolio and the Core Capital team will be implementing a majority of those projects. The Project Manager will be selected to responsible for the day-to-day management of various projects included in the Capital Plan and Agency Major Maintenance Program.

Reporting to a Program Manager at JFK, the selected candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day management of various projects included in Port Authority Capital Plan and Agency Major Maintenance Program. This position requires the candidate to work from the relevant airport with one day per week of work from home permitted. The selected candidate will be responsible for the management of full project life cycle including initiating, planning, executing, monitoring/controlling, and closing for each assigned project.

Additional Information:

The successful candidate will be required to apply, obtain and be able to maintain Security Identification Display Area (SIDA) Card and airfield driving privileges.

Responsibilities

* Develop detailed project scope of work based on a statement of problem, inputs from facility, engineering and stakeholders, or a desired outcome.
* Establish project economics and timeline in conjunction with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Collaborate with the Engineering Department to retain necessary internal and external resources, including appropriate professional services, to advance assigned projects to conceptual/preliminary design or final design and construction. Ensure staff budgets are appropriate and maintained throughout the project.
* Advancement of projects in planning, design, construction and closeout through established milestones and project schedules, developing and implementing recovery plans for unanticipated delays.
* Conduct regularly scheduled meetings with appropriate parties to ensure the project scope, schedule, and budget are maintained.
* Interact with Port Authority staff departments and outside agencies to establish agreements, force accounts and the like in support of project work.
* Take the lead in establishing project risk parameters, completing risk assessments, and developing the appropriate risk contingency plans.
* Prepare project status reports for supervisors, senior, and/or executive staff on a periodic basis.
* Prepare the necessary material/presentations for capital project authorization process.
* Management of design and construction activities to ensure that all phases of work are completed within budget, contracted schedule, and in accordance with plans and specifications.
* Ensure projects are properly completed and closed out in accordance with established agency processes.

Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or architecture from an accredited college or university.
* Minimum of three (3) years of progressively responsible experience leading the design, construction, and/or project management of infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of the principles, methods, and tools for developing, scheduling, coordinating, and managing projects and resources.
* Possess valid driver’s license.

Desired Qualifications

* Professional Engineer (PE) or Registered Architect (RA) in the State of New York or New Jersey
* Certified Project Management Professional (PMP)
* Demonstrated ability to multi-task and manage challenging and complex projects in an airport environment.
* Knowledge of Aviation facility operations and Aviation planning and design.

  

Selection Process

The application process varies by position, but typically includes an initial phone interview for qualified candidates, followed by a more in-depth interview(s) and/or assessment(s). Selected candidates who are made a conditional job offer will be asked to undergo a background check.

Compensation, Benefits & On-Site Collaboration Requirements:

  

The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey offers a competitive benefits package and a professional environment that supports development and recognizes achievement. Click here for more information about benefits, our culture, and career development opportunities.

The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey anticipates that the actual salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on aspects such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal factors. The expected compensation range for this role is:

Minimum: $90,012 Midpoint: $117,018 Maximum: $144,014

In accordance with Port Authority policy, this position permits employees to work remotely a maximum of one day per week. In person collaboration is essential to how the Port Authority conducts business, and regular in-office days or team collaboration days may be required on business needs.

jobs.description:
**Description**

  
  
  
  

JOB TITLE:

Assistant Project Manager (LIRR)

  

AGENCY:

Construction & Development

DEPT/DIV:

Delivery/LIRR

REPORTS TO:

Project Manager

144-41 94th Ave. Queens

JOB FAMILY: CON

GRADE: 002

SALARY RANGE:

$84,893 to $106,117

DEADLINE:

Open Until Filled

May need to work outside of normal work hours (i.e., evenings and weekends)

Travel may be required to other MTA locations or other external sites.

MTA Construction & Development reserves the right to remove this posting before the application deadline.

Agency Mission

MTA Construction & Development (C&D) is responsible for the planning, development, and execution of all capital construction projects across the MTA region. Through centralized oversight and management of the MTA’s $64 billion Capital Program, C&D ensures the efficient delivery of critical infrastructure projects that support the region’s vast transportation network. As part of the Metropolitan Transportation Authority, the largest transportation network in North America, C&D plays a key role in modernizing and expanding services that support 15.3 million residents across New York City, Long Island, southeastern New York State, and Connecticut. C&D is committed to delivering safe, innovative, and cost-effective capital projects that enhance the customer experience and strengthen the reliability and resilience of the MTA system.

Telework

This position is eligible for telework, which is currently one day per week. New hires are eligible to apply 30 days after their effective date of hire.

Job Summary

The Assistant Project Manager manages capital project delivery within the LIRR business unit in the MTA Construction Development (C&D) Delivery Department. This position is part of the project management team responsible for ensuring that project delivery is safe, efficient, on schedule, within budget, and according to project documents, contractual requirements, and relevant policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines.

The Assistant Project Manager monitors project status and identifies project risks and issues. This position assists the Project Manager with management, coordination, field oversight, and inspection of capital projects. This position coordinates daily project delivery activities with C&D staff, contractors, consultants, and agency forces to support the safe and efficient execution of capital projects.

Responsibilities

The Assistant Project Manager is responsible for successfully managing and mentoring staff to deliver complex capital projects.

Coordinate project activities through project close-out.

Monitor project performance against established baselines and pursue opportunities for improved performance.

Identify project issues and risks and ensure timely resolution and mitigation.

Recommend solutions to senior management for the resolution of critical issues.

Manage project activities to minimize the impact on agency operations and the public.

Coordinate project activities with the project team, C&D staff, contractors, consultants, MTA operating agency staff, and other stakeholders.

Coordinate with MTA operating agency staff to ensure necessary actions, approvals, and resources are in place to support project delivery.

Ensure project activities follow established requirements and adhere to all relevant standards, guidelines, codes, regulations, policies, and procedures.

Ensure that safety and quality are an integral part of project operations.

Manage the preparation and monitor implementation of project plans, quality plans, and work plans.

Coordinate with Safety and Quality Management staff.

Manage project documentation to ensure quality, completeness, and accuracy.

Manage and monitor progress against project scope, schedule, and budget.

Work collaboratively with Development and Contracts throughout the project life-cycle, including developing project scope, requirements, design criteria, and procurement packages, evaluating bids/proposals, negotiating change orders, and timely completing the contractor/consultant evaluation process.

Review and approve contract invoices and other project charges based on established procedures.

Ensure that expenditures are correctly charged.

Manage comprehensive project document control and retention.

Manage the preparation of reports, presentations, research, and studies.

Manage the presentation of project reporting and coordination of audit/inquiry responses for MTA and external oversight bodies.

Manage staff selection, coaching, training, development, evaluation, and discipline/termination as needed.

Create a professional environment that respects individual differences and enables all employees to develop and contribute to their full potential.

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction or Project Management, Business Administration, Transportation, or a related field.

Must have a minimum of (3) years of related experience.

A Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) / Engineer-In-Training (EIT) certificate is desirable.

A licensed Professional Engineer (PE) or Registered Architect (RA) is desirable.

PMP and CCM Certifications are preferred.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Proficient computer skills (i.e., Windows environment, Microsoft Office, PeopleSoft, Oracle, etc.) and strong business administrative skills (i.e., presentations, report and letter writing, time management, etc.).

40

Compliance

jobs.title: Sr. Business Transformation Specialist/Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Broadridge is seeking an experienced, execution-oriented Sr. Business Transformation Specialist to join the US Proxy Business Transformation & Special Projects team. This role combines hands-on business transformation, process improvement, analysis, and implementation responsibilities with strong project management discipline. The Sr. Business Transformation Specialist will independently lead cross-functional projects from initiation through implementation while helping assess business processes, define solutions, and drive broader transformation initiatives. The successful candidate will have significant experience leading projects end-to-end and will be comfortable taking a business objective or problem, creating the structure and plan needed to address it, organizing stakeholders, managing risks and dependencies, and driving execution with limited day-to-day direction. Projects may range from targeted operational improvements to larger, multi-workstream initiatives involving Business, Operations, Technology, Product, Risk, clients, vendors, and other enterprise stakeholders.

**Responsibilities:**

**Business Transformation & Analysis**

* Analyze current-state business processes, workflows, systems, controls, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Facilitate discussions with stakeholders to identify pain points, inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Support the design of practical future-state processes and solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, controls, and client experience.
* Identify opportunities for standardization, simplification, automation, and workflow redesign.
* Gather and document business requirements and identify gaps, dependencies, or unresolved questions.
* Conduct analysis to support impact assessments, business cases, implementation strategies, and decision-making.

**Governance, Risk & Stakeholder Management**

* Develop and maintain project plans, milestone trackers, action and decision logs, risk and issue registers, and other key project materials.
* Track progress against timelines and proactively address risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes, and resource constraints.
* Escalate matters appropriately with clear context, business impact, options, and recommended next steps.
* Coordinate execution across cross-functional stakeholders and maintain momentum in a matrixed organization.
* Facilitate effective working sessions that result in clear decisions, ownership, actions, and next steps.
* Prepare concise project updates and executive-ready materials that accurately communicate project health, progress, risks, and decisions required.

**Implementation & Change Readiness**

* Lead or coordinate implementation and readiness activities across impacted teams.
* Coordinate requirements, testing, process changes, operational readiness, communications, training, and deployment activities as applicable.
* Develop implementation plans, readiness criteria, and go-live approaches where established processes do not yet exist.
* Drive resolution of implementation risks and dependencies and support post-launch stabilization and transition to ongoing business ownership.

**Project Leadership & Delivery**

* Independently lead multiple cross-functional projects from initiation through implementation and stabilization.
* Translate business objectives into structured project plans with clear scope, deliverables, milestones, dependencies, owners, and timelines.
* Establish the appropriate governance, working cadence, and project structure based on the needs and complexity of the initiative.
* Proactively drive execution, maintain accountability, and identify next steps without requiring significant day-to-day direction.
* Bring structure to ambiguous or evolving initiatives where requirements, responsibilities, or execution paths may not initially be clear.

**Build Transformation & Project Management Capabilities**

* Partner with the head of the Business Transformation & Special Projects team to help build and mature the operating framework.
* Help establish practical, scalable project management and transformation standards for initiatives of varying size and complexity.
* Develop and refine templates, tools, and repeatable approaches for project intake, scoping, planning, governance, status reporting, risk management, requirements, process documentation, implementation readiness, and project closeout.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate project tracking and reporting.
* Apply lessons learned from active initiatives to continuously improve team practices.

**Business Knowledge & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop a strong working understanding of US Proxy, Corporate Actions, and related operational processes, technology workflows, systems, and controls.
* Build sufficient business knowledge to understand the broader context and implications of assigned initiatives.
* Apply project experience and business knowledge to identify improvement opportunities beyond the immediate project or assignment.

**Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of hands-on complex project management experience, including independently leading projects from initiation through implementation and completion.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership of projects with limited established structure and determine the approach needed to drive successful execution.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Business, Operations, Technology, Product, or other enterprise stakeholders.
* Strong experience managing project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, actions, and status reporting.
* Experience with business process analysis, requirements gathering, process improvement, transformation, or implementation activities.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
**Hi! We're Forerunner.**
=========================

Stronger, more resilient communities are built by the people inside government and regulated industries who keep critical infrastructure running. But they're working against real headwinds: fragmented data, field crews without the right tools, and high-stakes decisions made without a complete picture.

Forerunner exists to fix that. We build intelligent software that connects the systems these agencies and firms already rely on, fills the gaps those systems can't, and turns fragmented information into decisions and actions that reduce liability, surface revenue, and prevent small problems from becoming emergencies.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Deployment Specialist, you will own the end-to-end deployment experience for our customers — from discovery to go-live — ensuring the outcome aligns with business impact. You’ll act at the intersection of strategy, project management, and operational delivery, collaborating with customers, internal teams, and technical resources to make deployments high-quality, repeatable, and outcome-driven.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Customer Discovery & Planning**

* Lead structured workshops with customers to uncover business objectives, operational constraints, and success metrics.
* Translate findings into a clear deployment roadmap and set of deliverables.
* Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and governance.

### **Project Leadership**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer during deployment.
* Coordinate across cross-functional teams (Forward Deployed Engineer, Customer Success Manager, other internal stakeholders) to ensure alignment and momentum.
* Proactively identify risks, manage dependencies, and escalate when necessary.
* Provide regular status updates to both the customer and internal leadership.

### **Solution Design & Oversight**

* Using both the product front-end and Forerunner MCP, configure client systems and ensure system design stays aligned with business goals.
* Work with the Forward Deployed Engineer to scope integrations and customizations.
* Ensure that deployment deliverables map back to the business requirements and success criteria.

### **Customer Enablement & Handoff**

* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) and drive readiness for go-live.
* Collaborate with the Customer Success Manager to ensure a smooth transition to the ongoing success phase.
* Document lessons learned, refine the playbook, and drive continuous improvement across deployments.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4-6 years of experience in project management, SaaS implementation delivery, customer consulting, and operations. Experience with GIS or construction project management is a plus.
* Strong ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured, executable plans.
* Excellent communication skills with both technical and executive stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment where you are building repeatable processes

### **You’ll thrive in this role if you…**

* Believe in delivering measurable outcomes to customers, not just checking off tasks.
* Enjoy being the glue across teams, driving clarity, and removing friction.
* Are comfortable juggling strategic thinking and tactical execution.
* Want to build and refine playbooks that scale, not just follow them.

**Our team has a lot to offer.**
--------------------------------

Forerunner is an early stage company with an interdisciplinary team. We are motivated by seemingly intractable problems and work hard to support one another.

* **We're mission-driven.** Our mission orients our business strategy and pushes us to work with a sense of urgency. We’re in the weeds - our entire team spends time engaging with our partners in the field to better understand the real-world problems they face.
* **We're a small team.** As a member of our growing team, you will quickly become an invaluable part of our organization and have a meaningful impact on our business and technical direction. We welcome unique perspectives and backgrounds. Your opinion matters and we hope you'll share it.
* **We value in-person collaboration**. Some of our best work happens when we're solving problems together in the same room, so this role is hybrid and based near one of our offices: New York City, San Francisco, or Portland, Maine.
* **We want you to be happy and healthy.** Forerunner offers competitive compensation, health/vision/dental coverage, and commuter benefits. We also have a quarterly wellness reimbursement so that you can have flexibility in defining what “health” means to you.

The salary range for this position is 120,000-165,000. This posting may span more than one career level. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including an individual's skills, experience, and qualifications.

Forerunner is an equal opportunity employer committed to embracing diversity and the perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds.

Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. #### **Who You Are**

* Curious, proactive, and team-oriented with a bias toward action
* A self-starter with a "how do we get better" mindset. You naturally spot friction in processes and move to fix it

**Our Values**

* **Drive Innovation -** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* **Embrace Learning -** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Data Center Design Engineering team.  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The ideal candidate should thrive in ambiguity and competing priorities. Be an exceptionally strong communicator both written and verbally who can translate complex technical schedules into clear executive narratives. Possess a strong sense of organization, accountability, and team building that fosters robust working relationships across internal and external stakeholders. Are comfortable managing remote delivery teams and can navigate mechanical/electrical engineering concepts with confidence. Are relentless about on-time delivery and treat every missed milestone as a learning opportunity to improve the system.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with internal and external Amazon customers and support teams to gain insights and capture critical mechanical, electrical and utility needs for the business today and in the future
* Utilize those insights to identify specific program requirements, create a program vision, and own the product development roadmap for critical segments of the data center physical infrastructure
* Coordinate between multiple teams to develop compelling business cases to substantiate business value, define product prioritization, and outline budget and resources required to implement product roadmaps
* Drive continuous advancements and improvements within our data center designs, and communicate technical solutions to Senior Management
* Own and drive the complete product lifecycle from idea conception through implementation and wide scale deployment to eventual deprecation
* Develop product features and deployment strategies to improve performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency of new applications and use cases
* Communicate complex issues clearly and effectively to leadership to propose solutions and fully inform risk decisions
* Work independently in a high-performing environment with all levels of leadership and exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
* 5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**For our shareholders**, AMO provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.
