jobs.description:
Description:

The Project Manager leads the team that produces recurring statistical reports using near real-time data from multiple federal sources. This leader owns the schedule, quality, and accountability for every daily, weekly, and monthly product and keeps the team responsive to shifting operational needs.

**Location: Primarily Remote.**

Requirements:

**Reporting Delivery**

* Coordinate and ensure on-time delivery, seven days a week, of distinct daily, weekly, and monthly reports on immigration and border activity.
* Maintain a year-round production calendar and staffing plan, including weekend and holiday coverage, so no scheduled report is missed.
* Ensure each report is accurate, relevant, and responsive to operational needs, giving leadership daily data to support tracking and decision-making.
* Oversee distribution of reports to government leadership, Congress, the White House, and interagency partners per government requirements.
* Manage intake and integration of near real-time data feeds from numerous government sources; track data delivery issues and coordinate fixes with source agencies.
* Establish quality control checks and review steps for every report before release; track and resolve any errors or corrections.
* Respond quickly to ad hoc and urgent data requests from government leadership without disrupting the recurring schedule.

**Methodology Alignment & Documentation**

* Coordinate with data processing and governance teams to document reporting methodologies clearly and completely.
* Align methods used for real-time, unverified data with those used for core reporting based on official production data, to the extent practicable.
* Track and communicate known differences between real-time reporting and official monthly statistics so recipients understand them.
* Maintain version-controlled methodology documentation, data definitions, and change logs for all reporting products.

**Project Administration**

* Meet at least weekly with the Contracting Officer Representative (COR) and/or other stakeholders to review project status, reporting performance, and data issues.
* Proactively manage project resources; lead the team in defining and maintaining high performance standards.
* Lead the alignment of the strategy and approach for initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, controlling, and closing the project with key stakeholders.
* Coordinate and manage a team of developers and data analysts, statisticians, and business and/or technical Subject Matter Experts.
* Provide guidance to all team members on project scope, objectives, schedule, quality, and expectations.
* Track status for all project deliverables, including every recurring report, ensuring ownership and accountability for each.
* Ensure that all projects are delivered on-time, within scope, and within budget.
* Develop complete and accurate weekly and monthly status reports, including team activities, report delivery performance, and progress toward project milestones, as well as risks, issues, and decisions.
* Measure project performance using appropriate tools and techniques, such as on-time delivery rate, error and correction rates, and data feed timeliness.
* Appropriately and quickly escalate significant issues, dependencies, and risks, including late or anomalous source data.
* Independently manage multiple tasks and adjust to changing priorities to meet multiple deadlines.

The Surety Programs Group (SPG) supports government and private sector management of complex safety, security, and reliability programs for high consequence operations. jobs.title: All-Source Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**

Threats to the nation and our military are regularly evolving and becoming more complex. What if you could apply your proficiency as an all-source analyst to weaken these developing threats and contribute to the security of our country's dynamic military resources? With all the information accessible today, it takes a capable specialist to know how to collect, organize, and present data concisely to clients. If you have professional or military experience in all-source analysis, along with a "can-do" mindset, we have an opportunity for you to use those skills to help enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of senior government and military decision-makers and planners, and support real-world missions in a dynamic, client environment.

  
  

As an All-Source Intelligence Analyst, you will conduct analysis using intelligence and information from multiple sources to assess, interpret, forecast, and explain a range of national security issues and developments that are regional or functional in nature. You will generate written intelligence products in accordance with Intelligence Community tradecraft standards using a wide range of intelligence resources and tools and brief analysis to senior DoD leaders. You will produce whitepapers, regional threat analysis and assessments, and short and long-term assessments.

  
  

Join us. The world can't wait.

  
  

**You Have:**

* Experience with DoW and IC all-source analysis tools
* Experience analyzing and producing all-source intelligence data, including on technical topics, such as mitigating CBRNE or advanced conventional weapons, to produce compliant strategic and foundational intelligence products
* Experience with ICD 203 and ICD 206 compliant production
* Ability to define problems, refine key intelligence questions, conduct studies and analysis, and respond to customers’ requests for further information (RFI)
* TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
* Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience conducting all-source intelligence analysis, or 12+ years of experience conducting all-source intelligence analysis in lieu of a degree
  

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience conducting all-source intelligence analysis for WMD topic areas and nuclear programs, including nuclear fuel cycle processes and nuclear weapons programs
* Experience analyzing and producing all-source intelligence in the EUCOM area of responsibility
* Experience disseminating and integrating all-source intelligence analysis using foundational military intelligence databases
  

  

**Clearance:**

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

HII designs, develops, integrates and manages the sensors, systems and other assets necessary to support integrated ISR operations and accelerated decision-making. With data fusion and mission management capabilities for the Department of Defense, the combatant commands and the intelligence community, HII advances the mission around the globe.

  

**Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies**

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

ONS provides enterprise-level Counterintelligence, Insider Threat, and Intelligence support to customers across HHS. This position will fall under the Intelligence Division and will focus on providing insider-threat analysis, risk identification, and analytic support to senior HHS leaders. The selected specialist will help identify, assess, and communicate emerging insider-risk concerns; support CI integration across ONS; and contribute to Department-level protection and security missions consistent with ONS workforce requirements.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

The selected candidate will be responsible for conducting comprehensive insider-threat analysis, integrating behavioral, technical, and counterintelligence indicators; to identify, assess, and elevate potential risks across the HHS. The candidate will provide and support briefings to senior departmental leaders and Operating/Staff Divisions, ensuring decision-makers maintain awareness of emerging insider-threat trends, foreign intelligence risks, and organizational vulnerabilities, consistent with ONS insider-threat engagement practices. The candidate will develop and maintain trusted working relationships with HHS principals and key mission partners, enabling timely information sharing and coordinated risk-mitigation actions in alignment with enterprise insider-threat expectations such as those outlined in the insider-threat PMAP core functions. Responsibilities include identifying emerging threats within the assigned portfolio; collaborating with federal, IC, and departmental partners; participation in ONS insider-threat–related working groups and interagency meetings; and producing high-quality analytic and operational insider-threat products consistent with established CI/ITP tradecraft standards.

* Active TS/SCI

* Comprehensive knowledge of sensitive-sector risks affecting HHS, including research-security vulnerabilities, biomanufacturing threats, supply-chain exposures, and foreign-intelligence targeting; aligned with federal and departmental insider-risk frameworks
* Ability to assess, interpret, and weigh source reliability and credibility; distinguish fact from judgment; and evaluate alternative hypotheses
* Proven ability to conduct trend and pattern analysis, synthesize fragmented information, and identify analytic gaps to inform risk-mitigation strategies

* Experience with analytical research tools and demonstrated knowledge of databases and intelligence portals, including platforms used for information sharing and analytic collaboration such as HSIN, IC portals, web-based intelligence systems, and internal ONS/CI data environments, consistent with ONS onboarding materials and analytic-collaboration standards

jobs.title: OSINT Analyst
jobs.description:
Blue Sky Innovators is seeking an OSINT Analyst to join our team in the Washington, DC area. The OSINT Analyst performs open-source intelligence research and analysis to identify threats and provide situational awareness for sensitive protective operations. Working onsite at a government facility, the analyst researches, evaluates, and reports on publicly and commercially available information concerning individuals, groups, and activities that may pose a threat to protected persons, facilities, and events, and prepares timely, accurate analytic products for authorized operational and intelligence personnel. The role directly supports protective and investigative missions and may require travel to domestic or international operational sites.

**Key Responsibilities**

Open-Source Research and Threat Analysis

* Conduct open-source research across the surface, deep, and dark web, social media, forums, and messaging platforms to identify and assess threats to protected persons, facilities, and events.
* Research, review, and evaluate a high volume of open-source information; determine relevance, priority, and validity as it pertains to the protective mission, and identify conflicts or gaps in the data.
* Support analysis across assigned threat areas, including hostile or unusual interest, transnational and domestic terrorism, counterintelligence, cyber, and open-source threats.
* Monitor online activity and emerging trends relevant to the assigned subject area or geographic region and alert authorized personnel to developing threats.
* Conduct research on persons and groups of protective interest in support of protective intelligence investigations, consistent with applicable policy and privacy and civil-liberties requirements.

Protective Travel and Event Support

* Provide and coordinate open-source support for senior official and other protected-person travel, as well as designated high-security events.
* Support intelligence coordinators at domestic or foreign command post sites before and during protectee visits, including real-time open-source monitoring, incident and situation reporting, and short-notice briefings.
* Assist with debriefings of investigative and protective personnel returning from domestic and foreign travel, and incorporate findings into analytic products and future trip assessments.

Analytic Products and Briefings

* Draft finished open-source intelligence products, information bulletins, and situation reports on individuals, groups, and activities affecting protected interests, for authorized review and dissemination.
* Draft open-source assessments supporting threat and risk assessments for protected persons, sites, and events.
* Prepare and deliver oral and written briefings to senior management and, as directed, authorized partner organizations.
* Support review of potentially threatening correspondence and online communications and provide analytic input for authorized follow-up decisions.
* Ensure products are timely, complete, accurate, and compliant with applicable protective intelligence policy and dissemination controls.

Tradecraft, Tools, and Training Support

* Apply sound OSINT tradecraft, including managed attribution and operational security, using government-provided tools and accounts.
* Help evaluate new OSINT tools, data sources, and techniques, and provide user input on system requirements and acceptance testing.
* Help develop training materials on open-source technology and methodology, and support onboarding of newly assigned analysts and operational personnel as directed.
* Maintain accurate records of research activity, sources, and products in accordance with applicable records, information-handling, and security requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Must be a U.S. citizen.
* Active TS/SCI clearance, or the ability to obtain and maintain TS/SCI with sponsorship as needed; willingness to submit to additional security screening if required.
* Bachelor's degree in intelligence studies, international relations, political science, criminal justice, or a related field, plus a minimum of five (5) years of intelligence analysis experience, at least three (3) of which in open-source/OSINT research; additional qualifying experience may substitute for the degree.
* Demonstrated experience with OSINT collection and analysis across social media, forums, the deep and dark web, and commercial and public-records data sources.
* Working knowledge of OSINT tradecraft, managed attribution, and operational security practices.
* Strong inductive and deductive reasoning; ability to evaluate fragmentary, inconsistent, or unverified information and develop sound analytic judgments.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, including concise finished intelligence writing and briefing to senior officials.
* Ability to work rotating shifts, nights, weekends, and holidays; to perform under high stress and short suspense; and to travel domestically and internationally (vaccinations may be required).

Preferred Qualifications

* Active TS/SCI with polygraph.
* Prior protective intelligence, threat assessment, or behavioral threat analysis experience within federal law enforcement, national security, diplomatic security, or the Intelligence Community.
* Experience supporting major special events or senior-official and dignitary travel.
* Familiarity with domestic violent extremism, transnational terrorism, counterintelligence, or cyber threat actors.
* Foreign language proficiency relevant to protective travel or threat areas.
* OSINT certifications or formal training from recognized government, academic, or industry programs.
* Experience with commercial OSINT, social media monitoring, link-analysis, or geolocation tools.

Knowledge and Skills

* Knowledge of protective operations and the role of protective intelligence in risk assessment and resource allocation.
* Knowledge of intelligence analytic standards and structured analytic techniques.

* SQL querying skills, AWS tools skills

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

BryceTech is a trusted leader in complex technology domains, delivering data-driven solutions in aerospace, biosecurity, and defense. We specialize in systems engineering, advanced analytics, R&D programs, and strategic advisory support. Our clients – including NASA, DoD, HHS, DHS, and other civil and national security agencies – rely on us to drive mission success and accelerate innovation.

BryceTech has been recognized in the *Washington Technology* Fast 50 ranking of top high-growth small businesses for five consecutive years and received a GovCon Contractor of the Year Award in 2025, underscoring our strong growth, competitive positioning, and excellence in federal contracting. With a proven track record of winning sought-after contracts, scaling high-performance teams, and executing on critical government missions, BryceTech presents a compelling opportunity for strategic partnerships in the GovCon space.

 **Job Description**

BryceTech is seeking a Senior Emergency Response Operations Analyst to fill a critical need supporting the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Office of Emerging Threats (OET). OET’s mission requirements focus on identifying, assessing, and informing FEMA and its mission partners about emerging threats that could challenge national response and recovery capabilities. This mission area covers a broad spectrum of evolving hazards, from cyberattacks and climate-driven impacts to advanced weapons technologies, requiring strong analytical support, cross-agency collaboration, and integration of intelligence, data analytics, and risk assessments to drive FEMA operational planning and capability development.

The Senior Emergency Response Operations Analyst will provide senior-level analytical, planning, and program support for complex emergency response and preparedness initiatives. The person in this role will:

* Lead analysis of emergency response and preparedness plans, policies, programs, and capabilities related to emerging and high-consequence threats
* Conduct strategic assessments and gap analyses to identify vulnerabilities, capability gaps, and opportunities to strengthen national response and recovery capabilities
* Develop recommendations, plans, policies, procedures, and other products to support FEMA leadership and mission partners
* Provide senior-level analytical support for complex scenarios involving CBRN, nuclear/radiological incidents, emerging threats, and other hazards with potential national-level consequences
* Lead coordination with FEMA leadership, federal agencies, state and local partners, and other stakeholders on complex emergency management and preparedness initiatives
* Develop executive-level briefings, presentations, reports, read-ahead materials, talking points, and other products for senior FEMA leadership
* Support the planning, coordination, and execution of exercises, tabletop exercises, workshops, and other preparedness activities
* Evaluate lessons learned, after-action findings, and operational feedback to identify improvements to emergency response programs and capabilities
* Support the development and sustainment of program plans, standard operating procedures, operational guidance, and other program documentation
* Research emerging threats, hazards, policies, technologies, and response capabilities and translate findings into actionable recommendations
* Provide subject matter expertise and guidance to FEMA personnel and mission partners on emergency preparedness, response, recovery, and capability development
* Facilitate working groups, interagency meetings, and stakeholder engagements and translate discussions into actionable requirements, recommendations, and follow-up activities
* Prepare materials and analysis supporting senior leadership engagements, testimony, communications, and strategic decision-making
* Independently manage multiple complex assignments and coordinate deliverables across government and contractor stakeholders
* Mentor and provide guidance to junior analysts and other team members
* Ensure contractor-developed products and materials meet applicable quality and Section 508 accessibility requirements

  
**Qualifications**  

* US Citizenship and ability to obtain DHS Public Trust
* 11+ years of experience in emergency management, emergency response planning, preparedness, emerging threats, policy analysis, national security, or a related field
* Demonstrated experience conducting strategic or program-level analysis of emergency preparedness, response, recovery, or risk management programs
* Experience developing or evaluating emergency response plans, policies, procedures, capability assessments, gap analyses, or related program documentation
* Experience working with federal agencies, interagency partners, or other government stakeholders on complex emergency management or national preparedness initiatives
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex issues to senior leadership
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office products and Adobe Acrobat
* Proficiency creating Data Dashboards for senior leaders utilizing PowerBI or Tableau
* Ability to work independently, lead complex assignments, and collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams

  
**Additional Information**

BryceTech offers a full range of benefits, including competitive salary, a comprehensive health plan including dental and vision coverage, company-paid life & disability insurance policies, 401(k) plan with company match, and an educational reimbursement program.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
**Introduction**
----------------

The Maryland State Retirement Agency is the administrator of the Maryland State Retirement and Pension System (“System”). The System is a defined benefit retirement system covering State and local government employees of Maryland. It’s composed of twelve (12) separate retirement and pension systems with over 50 different rule sets. The System has over 433,000 participants (customers), including 210,000 members who are actively employed and participating in the System, 179,000 payees who receive a monthly payment from the System, and 44,000 vested members who are no longer actively employed but have earned a benefit that will become payable at a future date.

Located in Baltimore’s Central Business District, SRPS offers a purpose-driven workplace with modern amenities, including panoramic city and harbor views, renovated common areas, upgraded elevators, and an on-site café. Employees enjoy comprehensive state benefits including medical, dental, prescription coverage, generous paid leave, participation in the state pension system, and supplemental retirement savings options (401(k), 457(b), and more). Additional perks include an on-site fitness center with showers and lockers, 24/7 building security, and easy access to restaurants, shops, public transit, and major highways. If you're seeking a career with impact, stability, and a supportive environment, explore opportunities with MSRPS.

This position is designated as telework‑eligible (hybrid) under the State of Maryland’s Telework Policy, after successfully completing the defined required training period.

The agency is seeking to recruit for a SRPS Project Manager II (Project Manager, Business Operations Office) position. This position manages the projects within Business Operations Office in collaboration with Chief Business Operations Officer and Deputy Chief Business Operations Officer.

**This is a Management Service position and serves at the pleasure of the Appointing Authority.**

  

**GRADE**
---------

Grade 21

**LOCATION OF POSITION**
------------------------

120 East Baltimore Street Baltimore, Maryland 21202

**Main Purpose of Job**
-----------------------

The Project Manager for the Business Operations Office is responsible for planning, leading, coordinating, and delivering SRA’s business process re-engineering, technology, product enhancement, and organizational development initiatives using Agile Project Management methodologies. The position serves as a key liaison among business units, technology teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure projects align with SRA’s strategic and operational objectives and are delivered effectively.  
  

The Project Manager manages the full project lifecycle, including requirements gathering, planning, design, development, testing, implementation, training, and transition to ongoing operations and support. The position develops and maintains project plans, monitors schedules and deliverables, manages risks, issues, dependencies, and resources, and ensures timely escalation and resolution of project impediments.

  

The position works closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, business users, developers, vendors, and leadership to translate business requirements into effective solutions. The Project Manager also coordinates testing, quality assurance, stakeholder communication, training, and implementation activities.

  

Overall, the position ensures SRA’s business transformation initiatives are successfully implemented, adopted, and continuously improved to enhance operational efficiency, automation, service delivery, and stakeholder experience.

**POSITION DUTIES**
-------------------

The position manages projects from initiation through development, testing, implementation, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations.

  

Key duties and responsibilities include:

  

**Agile Project Planning and Management:** Develop and maintain Agile project plans, roadmaps, schedules, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, and success criteria. Ensure projects remain aligned with SRA’s strategic and operational objectives.

  

**Agile/Scrum Facilitation:** Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies. Promote collaboration, transparency, accountability, continuous improvement, and timely delivery.

  

**Cross-Functional Team Coordination:** Coordinate Business Operations Office staff, Product Owners, business analysts, developers, testers, technology teams, vendors, and business users. Establish responsibilities, monitor assignments, and address resource or dependency issues.

  

**Requirements and Delivery Coordination:** Work with Product Owners and stakeholders to translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable deliverables. Coordinate prioritization based on business value, operational needs, dependencies, and implementation readiness.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager; Catalog Strategy & Execution , Global Manufacturing and Distribution Services
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Senior Program Manager of Catalog Strategy & Execution is a strategic individual contributor role within the Global Manufacturing & Distribution Services organization. This position owns the critical link between enterprise procurement strategy and measurable buying behavior across Amazon. The role holder will consolidate what were previously separate project management and catalog strategy functions into a single, high-impact position that drives catalog integrity, program execution, spend compliance, and cross-functional alignment. This role also serves as the primary category liaison to the Category Strategy & Insights (CSI) team.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
This role directly supports savings targets and contributes to the broader organizational goal of net cost reductions. The position influences procurement decisions, catalog architecture, and purchasing governance across Amazon's global operations. The role holder will be instrumental in transitioning the organization from a fragmented, reactive catalog administration model to a centralized, strategic catalog function.  
  
Essential Job Functions  
  
Catalog Strategy & Governance: Define, own, and execute the end-to-end catalog strategy for Global Manufacturing & Distribution Services. Align catalog governance standards including taxonomy, item classification, supplier mapping, and content quality requirements with the Global Procurement Central Services team.  
  
Program Execution & Delivery: Lead cross-functional programs that translate sourcing decisions, supplier negotiations, and manufacturing investments into measurable catalog outcomes. Manage program timelines, milestones, dependencies, and risk mitigation plans.  
  
Spend Compliance & Adoption: Design and implement frameworks that drive enterprise-wide spend compliance with preferred supplier programs and negotiated contracts. Track, analyze, and report on user adoption rates and buying behavior to identify gaps and opportunities.  
  
CSI Category Liaison: Serve as the dedicated interface between the Global Manufacturing & Distribution Services category team and Strategic Initiatives. Ensure bi-directional alignment on procurement priorities, market intelligence, and category roadmaps.  
  
Savings Realization: Own savings pipeline and contribute directly to annual team savings targets. Develop business cases, track savings delivery, and report on financial performance against plan.  
  
Catalog Operations Transformation: Redesign catalog administration processes to eliminate fragmentation, reduce operational burden, and enable proactive management. Partner with technology teams to automate catalog workflows and improve data quality.  
  
Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with sourcing managers, procurement leaders, operations teams, finance, and technology partners across multiple pillars and regions. Prepare and present program updates, savings reports, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.  
  
Reporting & Analytics: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide visibility into catalog health, programs status, adoption metrics, and savings performance. Use data to drive decisions and continuous improvement.  
  
About the team  
Global Procurement Operations (GPO) is Amazon's worldwide procurement and facilities services organization, responsible for sourcing, managing, and delivering the operational services that keep Amazon's vast network running. GPO operates at massive scale spanning more than 15 countries across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, and Latin America.  
GPO's mission touches every corner of Amazon's physical operations. The organization manages strategic procurement across categories including facility services, third-party logistics (3PL), supplier management, sustainability, and site launch — ensuring Amazon's fulfillment centers, sort centers, and delivery stations are properly equipped and supported. GPO is also responsible for driving procurement innovation through technology, with a dedicated technology pillar focused on building the tools and systems that make world-class procurement possible at Amazon's scale.  
The organization is structured around regional and functional centers of excellence, each led by a senior director-level leader.  
  
GPO's corporate team includes approximately 1,400 procurement and supply chain professionals at levels working alongside a global network of on-site service partners embedded across Amazon's operational facilities. The team is highly global and distributed, with significant presence in the United States, Luxembourg, the United Kingdom, Japan, Spain, Brazil, the UAE, and beyond.  
  
Joining GPO means working at the intersection of strategic sourcing, operational excellence, and global scale — partnering with operations, finance, legal, and sustainability teams to deliver impact across one of the world's largest and most complex supply chains.

------------------------

* 6+ years of program or project management experience
* 5+ years of supply chain experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization

----------------------------

* 6+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

Serco is excited to continue supporting the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.

The F-35 JPO International Directorate (ID) is the focal point for all F-35 Fleet Users, to include U.S. Services, International Partners, and Foreign Military Sales programs to ensure ID integration throughout the F-35 enterprise and to ensure the delivery of 5th Generation combat capability to Warfighters in support of coalition operations. The Contractor shall provide support to the National Deputies who are the F-35 Program’s senior national representative for their Participant country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day-to-day representation of the cognizant Partner nation on all matters related to the F-35 Program. The Contractor shall provide support to the U.S. Service Deputies who are assigned to the JPO to ensure immediate/critical U.S. Service insight to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Senior Leadership Team (SLT). The Contractor shall provide support to the Foreign Military Sales USG Program Managers who represent the Foreign Military Sales Foreign Liaison Officers for country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day-to-day representation of the cognizant Foreign Military Sales nation on all matters related to the F-35 Program.

Our Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Policy Analyst (FMS Program Analyst), Joint Program Office (JPO), Crystal City, Arlington, VA, is responsible for advising JPO FMS leadership on current security cooperation policy, case development and case execution practices. Our Analyst reports to the Business Policy and Operations Manager, who is the principal policy and financial advisor to the FMS Program Manager, responsible for ensuring the FMS Program is in accordance with the Secretary of the Air Force International Affairs (SAF/IA), and Navy International Programs Office (NIPO) policies and procedures. Focus areas include: security cooperation and security assistance policy; manpower requirements; development, implementation, and execution of FMS cases; Letter of Request (LOR)/Letter of Offer and Acceptance (LOA) inputs, to include amendments and modifications; and process improvement.

You will be part of a dynamic team of F-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who works closely with the customer and other key F-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F-35 systems.

In this role, you will:

* Provide expert management in the areas of security cooperation policy, case development, and case execution.
* Interact with cross-functional agencies, to include SAF/IA, NIPO, AFSAC, and NAVAIR, to ensure current FMS policies and procedures support the function of the F-35 FMS Program.
* Review and interpret directives from higher authority regulations, instructions, periodicals, and publications to maintain current expertise and knowledge.
* Ensure new technology and lessons learned are incorporated into F-35 FMS processes; establishes suitable methods of assessing and continually improving processes.
* Develop, evaluate, advise, and improve efficiency and effectiveness of work methods and procedures, and manpower utilization.
* Coordinate with FMS Program Managers to advise and support country teams in the areas of policy, case development, and case execution.
* Coordinate with Security Cooperation Enterprise to assist country teams in completing Pricing and Availability (P&A), Letters of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs), amendment and modification packages in Security Cooperation systems, including DSAMS and RMIS.
* Use strong communication skills including the ability to communicate orally, via written letters and memorandum, email, and presentation. Ability to prepare and present convincing oral and written presentations at all levels of government and industry, and foreign allies.
* Manage Annual Case Reviews (ACR) required by the DSCA Reconciliation and Closure Manual (RCM), DoD 5105.65-M, is completed in a timely manner.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* The ability to provide onsite support at the F-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) at Crystal City, VA a minimum of 2 days per week, each week. Onsite days in the JPO office may increase to provide onsite support up to 5 days per week to support the needs of the customer. Exact days in office at the JPO must be coordinated with F-35 customer and approved by your Serco manager.
* An active DoD Secret Security clearance.
* A Bachelor’s degree plus a minimum of 3 years out of 6 years of recent work experience related to international acquisition programs.
  + OR an Associates degree and 4 years of additional work experience related to international acquisition programs (total of 10 years of work experience).
* Familiarity with DoD Instruction (DoDI) 5000.2 (Operation of the Defense Acquisition System), DoD Directive (DODD) 5530.03 (International Agreements), and the International Cooperation in Acquisition, Technology and Logistics (IC in AT&L) Handbook.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the principles, policies, and practices of system acquisition to plan, organize, and coordinate critical aspects of the development, production, deployment, and sustainment of systems, subsystems, and equipment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the Security Assistance/Security Cooperation (SA/SC) programs to include the understanding of the FMS sales process from case development, implementation, execution, to closure in accordance with the Security Assistance Management Manual (SAMM), DoD 5105.38-MX.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
**Position:** Deployment Strategist

**Location:** Washington DC (On-Site)

**About Belisar**

Belisar is the CRM designed for government contracting. It enables the best technology to win, fusing internal context, intuitive AI, and real-time data into a unified view of the market.

Federal contracting has long run on tools that were never built for it: Generic CRMs designed for commercial sales, legacy data platforms that surface noise instead of signal, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Belisar unifies all the important intelligence into a single, AI-native platform — so teams can see opportunities earlier, move faster, and win the work that matters.

Belisar is backed by a16z and trusted by leading defense, space, and government leaders including Boeing, Forterra, Scout AI, Vannevar Labs, Aevex, and the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU).

Together, we're building toward one outcome: The best technology wins, and it reaches the missions that need it most.

**The Role**

Deployment Strategists are the tip of the spear at Belisar: the people who sit at the intersection of software, strategy, and mission. This is not a traditional implementation role. You will embed directly with our customers in the national security and federal technology space, learn their hardest problems, and build the workflows, analyses, and operational capabilities that transform how they work.

You will work alongside engineers and GTM teams to shape the roadmap, represent the customer's voice inside Belisar, and ensure that our platform delivers measurable impact in the field. We are looking for people who thrive in ambiguity, build trust with operators and executives alike, and are driven by outcomes.

**What You’ll Do**

* Embed with customers to understand their workflows, priorities, and decision-making processes from the inside out
* Design and deploy tailored workflows and analytical tools using the Belisar platform to solve real operational problems
* Translate ambiguous mission requirements into clear product configurations, data integrations, and actionable insights
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with end users, program managers, and senior leaders at customer organizations
* Partner with Belisar's engineering teams to communicate what’s working, what’s missing, and what matters most
* Drive adoption and capability expansion within existing accounts, identifying new use cases and stakeholders
* Develop training materials, playbooks, and documentation that scale your impact beyond direct engagement
* Support business development by participating in demos, capability briefings, and proposal efforts

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2–5 years of experience in a high-impact, customer-facing role, either or already as a Deployment Strategist or Forward Deployed Engineer, or elsewhere, such as within consulting, federal contracting, SaaS implementation, or a hybrid.
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with operators and decision-makers in government or national security environments
* Strong analytical instincts: comfortable with data, able to structure complex problems, and fast at learning new tools
* A builder’s mindset: you don’t wait to be told what to do; you identify the gap and close it
* Outstanding communication skills with an ability to translate technical concepts for a variety of audiences.
* Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action in fast-moving, high-stakes environments
* Experience with government procurement, capture management, or the federal technology ecosystem is a strong plus.
* Bonus: if you are technical and can write code too!

**Qualifications**

* Located in or willing to relocate to Washington DC. This is a fully on-site position.
* US Person required
* Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply
* Willingness for regular customer travel

**Benefits**

Belisar offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

* Competitive salary and meaningful equity
* Platinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependents
* Basic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance fully covered, with the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents
* Relocation assistance available

Compensation Range: $100K - $140K

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

* Engage with internal and external Amazon customers and support teams to gain insights and capture critical mechanical, electrical and utility needs for the business today and in the future

jobs.title: Senior Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior Security Analyst

**Remote**

Blu Omega is seeking a Senior Security Analyst to support public health data modernization and advanced analytics initiatives for mission-critical federal programs. This role is responsible for protecting enterprise systems, applications, and data by identifying security risks, managing vulnerabilities, supporting system authorization activities, and ensuring compliance with federal security requirements. You will work closely with engineering, infrastructure, compliance, and program teams to enhance security across Windows, Linux, cloud, and enterprise technology environments.

**Program Overview**  
Supporting federal public health modernization efforts to improve data security and analytics capabilities.

**Key Details**  
Location: Remote
  
Clearance / Suitability: Public Trust eligibility required

**Responsibilities**

* Perform system hardening, vulnerability assessments, STIG remediation, and POA&M tracking across Windows, Linux, and cloud environments.
* Conduct vulnerability scanning and analysis using tools such as Nessus, AppScan, Fortify, WebInspect, Squirrel, or similar technologies.
* Analyze vulnerability scan results, translating technical findings into security risks, remediation actions, and mapping to NIST SP 800-53 security controls.
* Monitor endpoint security, identity and access management, privileged access management, and other enterprise security tools.
* Support system Security Assessment and Authorization (SA&A) activities, security control assessments, compliance reviews, and audits.
* Lead or support incident response activities, including investigation, documentation, stakeholder coordination, remediation, and process improvement.
* Conduct risk assessments and threat modeling to identify security weaknesses and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Develop and maintain security governance documentation, including policies, standards, operational procedures, security reports, business continuity materials, and authorization artifacts.
* Partner with system owners, engineers, and technical teams to validate remediation activities and ensure vulnerabilities are properly addressed.
* Support secure configuration management, least-privilege access controls, system authorization, and continuous monitoring activities.
* Identify opportunities to reduce attack surface, improve detection and response capabilities, and strengthen overall security posture.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, security assessment, or risk mitigation within regulated environments.
* Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning tools such as Nessus, AppScan, Fortify, WebInspect, or Squirrel.
* Experience analyzing vulnerability scan results and mapping findings to NIST SP 800-53 security controls.
* Experience performing system security assessments, SA&A activities, POA&M management, and compliance documentation.
* Strong understanding of system hardening, vulnerability remediation, security controls, and risk management.
* Ability to analyze complex technical security issues and develop actionable mitigation strategies.
* Strong written communication skills for developing security reports, policies, procedures, and audit documentation.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, compliance, program, and leadership teams.
* Active CDC badge/credentials.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination.
* U.S. Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card Holder).

**Salary Range**  
$150,000.00 - $165,000.00

**Blu Omega Benefits & Perks**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage through national providers
* 401(k) with company match (eligible after 6 months; vesting applies)
* Company-paid Life and AD&D insurance with additional voluntary options
* Short-term disability (company-paid) and long-term disability options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 24/7 confidential support and mental health resources
* Telehealth and virtual care options
* Pet insurance, legal services, and identity theft protection options
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid federal holidays
* Access to wellness programs, discounts, and lifestyle benefits

Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on role, employment status, and program requirements.

**Company Overview**  
Blu Omega is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) delivering technology and cybersecurity solutions to federal agencies and enterprise clients nationwide. Headquartered in Ashburn, VA, we support mission-critical programs across civilian and defense sectors, including health, national security, and regulatory environments. We partner with government agencies and large integrators to provide expertise in cybersecurity operations, cloud and infrastructure modernization, data and analytics, and enterprise IT support.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

#CJ #LI-Remote

Serco is excited to continue our support for the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.

The F-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) is a joint, multi-national program and is the Department of Defense’s (DoD) focal point for defining affordable next generation strike aircraft weapon systems among the United States (U.S.) Air Force (USAF), U.S. Navy (USN), U.S. Marine Corps (USMC), and U.S. allies currently composed of seven (7) cooperative international partners: the United Kingdom, Italy, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, Denmark, and Norway; as well as Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The F-35 is the next generation strike fighter bringing cutting-edge technologies to the battle-space of the future. The F-35’s advanced airframe, autonomic logistics, avionics, propulsion systems, stealth, and firepower will ensure that the F-35 is the most affordable, lethal, supportable and survivable aircraft ever to be used by so many warfighters around the world. The JPO is a product-aligned organization comprised of Program Management Offices (PMOs) designed to deliver five major products across the acquisition lifecycle: Air Vehicle, Propulsion, Combat Data Systems, Training Systems & Simulation, and Maintenance Systems.

Our Program Manager, located at Crystal City, VA, supports the F-35 JPO’s Directorate of Acquisition and Affordability (DA&A) in managing JPO functions as they relate to business operations, foreign compliance, process improvement, affordability, requirements, and acquisition.

You will be part of a dynamic team of F-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who work closely with the customer and other key F-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F-35 systems.

**This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain/transfer a DoD Secret security clearance.**

* Assist DA&A in managing procurement and enterprise procurement metrics.
* Provide program management and analysis support in Financial Improvement Audit Readiness (FIAR), enterprise earned value, data rights strategy, Integrated Product (IP), and the POM or Performance Based Regulation (PBR) process.

jobs.title: IT Program Manager
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**Background**

Every donation processed, every campaign that lands, every supporter who stays engaged — that's the technology you'll help build and deliver.

As **IT Program Manager**, you'll manage the digital platforms behind one of the world's leading humanitarian organizations, directly enabling the fundraising that funds life-saving programs for displaced communities across the globe. This is a high-impact, fast-paced role at the intersection of technology delivery, stakeholder engagement, and mission-driven purpose.

You'll be a core member of our Project Management team, working across a modern MarTech ecosystem — including donation and e-commerce platforms **(Fundraise Up, Springboard)**, our website **(Drupal)**, **Salesforce CRM**, **Databricks**, email marketing **(Pardot)**, and SMS platforms **(Mobile Commons, Mogli)**. You'll own the delivery of enhancements, integrations, and new capability launches that keep the IRC's digital supporter experience best-in-class.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Real-world impact** — your work directly supports humanitarian programs serving millions of people in crisis.
* **Breadth and ownership** — lead a complex, multi-platform portfolio with genuine strategic influence from day one.
* **Collaborative culture** — work alongside Product Managers, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders in a distributed, multicultural team that's deeply committed to its mission.
* **Modern delivery** — Agile/Scrum at the core, with room to shape how the team works.
* **Remote-first flexibility** — work from anywhere in the US as part of a truly global organization.

**What You'll Do**

**Drive end-to-end program delivery** Own the full lifecycle of multiple concurrent MarTech initiatives — from scope definition and roadmap planning through to launch and post-delivery review. Develop and maintain detailed project plans, work breakdown structures, and product backlogs, ensuring delivery against time, budget, and quality targets.

**Champion Agile ways of working** Serve as Scrum Master for your project and product teams — coaching on Agile principles, facilitating sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and reviews, and proactively removing blockers to keep delivery on track.

**Keep stakeholders informed and aligned** Prepare clear, timely status reports covering scope, milestones, risks, and budget. Communicate confidently with audiences from engineers to senior executives, tailoring your message appropriately. Manage expectations and build trust across business and technology teams.

**Manage budgets and vendors** Oversee budget tracking and vendor invoicing for your portfolio. Support cost estimation, validate expenditure, and contribute to the annual budget planning process to ensure initiatives are delivered within financial targets.

**Lead business analysis activities** Work with the team to define and track functional and technical requirements, document current and future state processes, and coordinate testing activities. Partner closely with Business Analysts to ensure delivery is grounded in well-understood business needs.

**Manage risk proactively** Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans. Surface issues early, escalate where needed, and keep the project leadership team ahead of potential blockers.

**Shape the roadmap** Partner with Product Managers to build out product and project roadmaps that reflect both business priorities and technical realities, contributing to a coherent long-term vision for the MarTech portfolio.

**What You'll Bring**

**You'll need:**

* 3-6 years of experience in IT project or program management, ideally across e-commerce systems, donation platforms, website CMS, or other Marketing Technology.
* A strong track record of delivering multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget.
* Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, or similar).
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira or Monday.com.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - comfortable engaging with variety of project collaborators from developers to executives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize data and drive decision-making.
* High levels of organization, initiative, and the ability to work independently in a distributed and fast-paced environment.

**It'd be great if you have:**

* Experience with any of the platforms in scope: Fundraise Up, Springboard, Drupal, Salesforce, Pardot, Databricks.
* Familiarity with non-profit fundraising, digital marketing, or supporter engagement processes.
* Experience managing third-party vendors and project budgets.
* Knowledge of SDLC methodologies (Waterfall and Agile).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio for producing high-quality project artifacts.

**Bonus points for:**

* A PMP, CSM, CSPO, or SAFe certification.
* Experience working in international development, human rights, or a related field.
* An understanding of payment processing platforms (Stripe, PayPal, etc.).

**Benefits and Working Environment**

* Standard office working environment.
* Currently the team is working in a hybrid model with one day

jobs.title: Customer Program Manager, Enterprise - Fixed-Term Contract (FTC)
jobs.description:
Botify’s leading agentic AI search technology and seasoned experts ensure every brand has the power to be found, both in traditional and AI search. With one powerful platform, brands achieve visibility, relevance, and greater control across Google, Bing, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and more.

Botify’s technology powers agentic workflows, AI-driven recommendations, and automated cross-platform indexation and deployment. Brands maximize visibility wherever consumers, bots, and AI agents search, protecting and capturing revenue across all search platforms.

Trusted by 500+ leading brands including Macy’s, Levi’s, Farfetch, the New York Times, and Marks & Spencer, Botify drives digital discovery, sustained profitability, productivity, and brand authority in an AI-first world.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

As a member of Botify’s Global Services Organization, the Customer Program Manager plays a crucial role in facilitating collaboration between Botify and its most strategic clients. They are instrumental in ensuring the seamless execution of multi-threaded implementation and service programs on the Botify platform. Customer Program Managers act as the linchpin connecting key stakeholders and initiatives, providing both structure and direction within client relationships and internally.

**️ Fixed-Term Contract (FTC)**

**Duration: 4 to 6 months, starting end of 2026**

### **Your responsibilities:**

* Maintain a portfolio of strategic customers, partnering closely with Botify Account Team members to drive strategy and cultivate long-term relationships with key client stakeholders.
* Identify key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop Success and Engagement plans to accelerate adoption and guide clients towards desired outcomes.
* Oversee and project manage product implementations for both new strategic customers and existing clients, expanding their Botify product scope.
* Regularly monitor and provide updates on client health and adoption to expand engagements and identify opportunities for maximizing value from Botify.
* Monitor platform functionality and integrations for customers, coordinating technical work with Botify's support team and global services resources when necessary.
* Coordinate and lead complex technical discussions in collaboration with Botify support or engineering team resources.
* Develop and deliver content for client-facing sessions and executive business reviews (both remote and on-site) in partnership with Account Managers and SEO Success Managers.
* Partner with Account Managers to identify and execute growth strategies.
* Assist in building and implementing internal processes to enhance efficiency in service delivery.

#### **Who we're looking for:**

##### **Your qualities:**

* Creative Problem Solver
* Autonomous and Independent
* Works well under pressure and in ambiguous situations
* Strong technical acumen

### **Experience:**

* 4+ years of experience in client-facing roles with a focus on Program Management, Project Management, Technical Customer Success, Implementation Management, or similar roles, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment.
* Significant customer-facing experience leading enterprise customers through business or technology transformations, with large account/project management experience.
* Experience working with complex enterprise software solutions.
* Proven ability to facilitate and contribute to complex technical discussions.
* Interest in SEO; previous experience in the industry is a plus.

#### **Salary**

£70,000 - £76,000 base salary + 15% bonus

#### **What's in it for you:**

* Unlimited paid annual leave and flexible working policies
* Workplace pension scheme with Penfold
* Employee referral program
* Private health insurance with Vitality (including medical, dental, mental health, and more)
* Wide range of benefits (ClassPass, Cyclescheme, train ticket loan & more)
* Regular Lunch & Learns, team socials and off-site events
* Travel stipend to work from our offices in Paris, London, New York and Singapore
* Opportunities for personal and professional development (career coaching with Bravely, social responsibility initiatives).

*Botify is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.*

If you feel strongly that you have what it takes for this role but don't check 100% of the boxes - that's okay - we encourage you to apply anyway and highlight what you can bring to the table!*

jobs.title: Fire and Security Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Fire and Security Project Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and execution of fire protection and security system projects. This role is vital in ensuring that all projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to a high standard. As a key driver of project success, you will oversee multiple projects simultaneously, liaising with clients, contractors, and internal teams. Your energetic approach and meticulous attention to detail will help us maintain our reputation for excellence in fire and security systems management.

**The Role**

* Permanent
* Office based when not out and about attending sites
* 21 days annual leave, plus statutory bank holidays, plus your birthday off. Additional days annual leave added for every 3 years of service (currently capped at 5 additional days)
* £45,000.00 - £55,000.00 annual salary dependant on experience
* Company car provided after successful completion of a probation period. Temporary vehicle can be provided until then if required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review, plan and execute project installations, ensuring all technical specifications and standards are met.
* Produce and issue risk and method statements (RAMS) and provide program of works.
* Coordinate with clients and stakeholders to understand project requirements and provide regular updates.
* Ensure WFP installation and commissioning engineers, as well as subcontract engineers, have the necessary tools and software for their jobs.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting during installations.
* Complete and issue any required variation quotes for additional works required outsideof the original scope of works.
* Monitor project profit and loss, measure the improvement in the margin from the sales estimate to the completed project.
* Provide certification, operation and maintenance literature.
* Conduct post-installation reviews and address any issues/snagging to ensure client satisfaction.
* Manage key client accounts, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and spotting potential technical errors or failures before they become customer complaints.
* Conduct wash-up meetings to review what went well on the project and identify any issues. Propose fixes for future projects.
* Ensure all the correct documentation is in place in accordance with the relevant British standards.
* Assist sales team with producing project quotes and ensure tender documents are correctly reviewed prior to quotes being submitted.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience managing fire protection or security system projects from inception to completion.
* Strong technical understanding of fire alarm and security systems.
* Strong proficiency in project scheduling and resource management.
* Excellent time management skills to prioritize tasks effectively across multiple projects.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications related to fire safety systems and security infrastructure.
* Exceptional communication skills to liaise confidently with clients, contractors, and internal teams.
* Demonstrated leadership qualities with a proactive approach to problem solving.
* Relevant certifications or training in fire safety systems or security management are a plus but not mandatory.

Pay: £45,000.00-£55,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company car
* Company pension
* Free parking
* On-site parking

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Stock CM4 9RS: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Experience:

* Fire and Security engineering: 5 years (required)
* Project management: 3 years (required)

Licence/Certification:

* Driving Licence (required)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Stock CM4 9RS

jobs.title: Sustainability Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Role:** Sustainability Project Manager

**Salary:** £32,034 - £40,043 (FTE £49,375)

**Hours:** 24 -30 hours per week (Worked over 3 or 4 days)

**Location:** Worthing/Hybrid

**Contract type:** 12-month Fixed Term Contract

At Worthing Homes, we're committed to providing high-quality homes and services that make a positive difference to our customers' lives. Sustainability is a key part of our future, helping us reduce carbon emissions, tackle fuel poverty, improve our homes, and build resilient communities.

We're looking for a driven and collaborative Sustainability Project Manager to join us on a 12-month Fixed Term Contract (maternity cover). This is an exciting opportunity to support the delivery of our environmental ambitions, influence change across the organisation, and contribute to our transition to net zero carbon.

Worthing Homes is a forward-looking housing association dedicated to providing affordable, high-quality homes and services to our local communities. We're a small but dynamic organisation, managing 4,000 homes serving over 10,000 residents across our range of properties from social housing to sheltered accommodation to shared ownership properties.

  

**About the Role**

As Sustainability Project Manager, you'll help deliver Worthing Homes' sustainability objectives and support the organisation's transition to a net zero future.

Working closely with colleagues across the organisation, you'll embed sustainability considerations into decision-making, lead on performance monitoring and reporting, and ensure we remain informed by emerging legislation, sector developments and best practice.

You'll manage and support on a range of projects focused on low carbon retrofit, energy efficiency and biodiversity improvements, while supporting our development team with low-carbon new homes. From identifying opportunities and managing budgets to evaluating outcomes and driving continuous improvement, you'll translate strategic priorities into practical initiatives that benefit our homes, customers and communities.

You'll also develop strong relationships with grant funding bodies, local authorities, contractors and sector partners to secure investment and maximise opportunities. Working closely with teams across procurement, operations, asset management and development, you'll promote sustainable approaches, encourage innovation and help deliver lasting environmental improvements across the business.

**About You**

We're looking for a collaborative and driven sustainability professional with experience delivering carbon reduction, energy efficiency or sustainability projects within housing, property, construction or the wider built environment. You'll be passionate about creating positive social and environmental impact and confident influencing others to embed sustainable practices.

You'll have a strong understanding of sustainability principles, energy and water efficiency measures, and approaches to tackling fuel poverty. Knowledge of the affordable housing sector would be an advantage.

With excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and project management skills, you'll be able to build strong partnerships, develop compelling business cases and funding bids, and deliver innovative solutions that support our journey to a more sustainable future.

**Why work for us?**

At Worthing Homes we strive to create a supportive and inclusive work environment ensuring colleagues feel valued and respected. We foster a collaborative culture in which teamwork is highly valued, and we employ brilliant people to work with our customers to help support them to live their best lives.

We offer a range of benefits including:

  

* Healthcare cash plan
* Contributory pension scheme - company matches up to 6%
* A generous annual leave package of 29 days per year plus bank holidays
* Life Assurance
* Retail and gym discounts
* Cycle2Work Scheme
* Employee assistance programme
* Funded training and qualifications
* Paid Professional Subscription (1 per year)

We are committed to investing in our colleague's development by offering a variety of opportunities for training, learning, and skills development, enabling everyone to reach their full potential and contribute to the success of Worthing Homes.

If you're passionate about sustainability, motivated by social purpose, and thrive on turning strategy into action, we'd love to hear from you.

Closing date**: 20th October 2026.** We reserve the right to close this advert early if a suitable candidate is identified, therefore we recommend you submit your application as soon as possible.

**DBS Checks**

This role is subject to a basic DBS check to support the safety of our vulnerable customers. Any unspent cautions or convictions disclosed will be reviewed carefully and fairly, with consideration given to their relevance, the time elapsed, and evidence of positive change.

*We are a fair and inclusive organisation, and we value each individual's unique contribution, irrespective of race, ethnic origin, religion, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or social background*

**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Salary:** Competitive, dependent on experience  
**Company Vehicle:** Available
