Oakstone Contracting is a growing highways and civil engineering contractor based in Chelmsford, Essex, delivering highway, infrastructure and civil engineering projects across the South East and London.

Our works include S278 and S50 highway works, highway maintenance and improvement works, drainage, kerbing, footways and cycleways, carriageway construction, surfacing, infrastructure and associated civil engineering works.

We also undertake projects for a range of clients, including direct works for Highway Authorities, Principal Contractors, developers and other private-sector clients.

Our direct Highway Authority works extend across **Essex, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire, Hertfordshire, Kent and London**, providing a varied portfolio of projects and client environments.

As the business continues to grow, we are looking to appoint an experienced and ambitious Highways Contract / Project Manager to take responsibility for the successful delivery of key projects and play an important role in the continued development of Oakstone's highways division.

This is a high-profile senior role within the business, with significant responsibility and autonomy. The successful candidate will be expected to take ownership of projects from pre-construction through construction, completion and commercial close-out.

Importantly, the role will involve not only managing projects once they are underway, but also planning, allocating, securing and appointing the labour, plant, subcontractors and wider resources required to successfully deliver the company's programme.

The Role

The Contract / Project Manager will have overall responsibility for the successful delivery, commercial performance and resourcing of allocated highways and civil engineering projects.

You will be responsible for translating project programmes into practical delivery plans, ensuring that the right people, plant, materials and subcontractors are secured and available at the right time.

You will act as a key point of contact for Highway Authorities, Principal Contractors, developers, consultants, subcontractors and the Oakstone management team, providing strong leadership and ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, commercially and to the required quality standards.

The role will suit an experienced highways professional who is commercially aware, technically competent, organised and confident dealing directly with clients and senior stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities include:

Project & Contract Management

* Take overall responsibility for the successful delivery of allocated highways and civil engineering projects.
* Manage projects from pre-start through construction, completion and final account.
* Establish clear project objectives, programmes, budgets and delivery strategies.
* Review contract documentation, drawings, specifications, scopes and employer requirements.
* Ensure works are delivered in accordance with contractual requirements and relevant Highway Authority standards.
* Identify project risks, opportunities, constraints and potential delays at an early stage.
* Maintain effective project records and ensure key decisions and instructions are documented.
* Coordinate project meetings and maintain clear action trackers.
* Ensure projects are properly closed out, including outstanding works, documentation, defects and commercial matters.
* Maintain overall ownership of project performance, ensuring issues are identified and dealt with proactively.

Highway Authority & Client Management

* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with Highway Authorities, Principal Contractors, developers, consultants and other stakeholders.
* Act as a senior and professional representative of Oakstone on site and at project meetings.
* Attend and lead client and progress meetings.
* Provide clear and regular updates on programme, progress, commercial position, risks and issues.
* Deal confidently with client queries, complaints, changes and challenges.
* Develop strong relationships with Highway Authority representatives and project teams to support repeat business.
* Understand and manage the different requirements and procedures associated with working for individual Highway Authorities.
* Represent Oakstone professionally and positively at all times.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen existing client relationships and support future work opportunities.

Labour, Resource & Supply Chain Management

A key part of the role will be the forward planning, allocation, securing and appointment of resources required to deliver Oakstone's workload.

Responsibilities will include:

* Take responsibility for identifying, allocating, securing and appointing the labour and resources required to successfully deliver allocated projects.
* Review project programmes and upcoming workload to identify labour, plant, subcontractor and specialist resource requirements in advance.
* Allocate available Oakstone labour and resources across projects in accordance with programme priorities and operational requirements.
* Source and secure additional labour, gangs, subcontractors and specialist resources where required.
* Liaise with labour agencies, subcontractors and suppliers to establish availability, competence, rates and suitability.
* Ensure appropriate resources are secured sufficiently in advance to maintain project programmes.
* Review labour requirements against changing programmes and adjust resource allocation accordingly.
* Work closely with Site Managers and Supervisors to ensure labour is effectively utilised and productivity is monitored.
* Ensure all externally sourced lab

jobs.title: Program Manager – Client Pathways Transformation, VP III - State Street Investment Management
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

State Street Investment Management (IM), formerly known as State Street Global Advisors (SSGA), is undertaking a multi-year transformation program to modernize its front, middle and back-office capabilities. This initiative is core to IM’s long-term strategy to increase operating leverage, improve scalability, and enhance service delivery for our investment teams.

  

We are seeking a Vice President, Program Manager to play a central role in driving this complex program forward. Reporting to the MD leading the initiative, this individual will help coordinate execution, engage with business and technology partners, and ensure outcomes are delivered in line with IM’s strategic objectives. The VP will act as a key connector across internal teams and State Street affiliates (Global Delivery, Global Technology Services, and Client Pathways), ensuring transparency, alignment, and accountability across all phases of the program.
  
  
This position sits within the Chief Operating Officer (COO) organization at IM and offers the opportunity to shape the future-state operating model for one of the world’s leading investment managers.

  

**Candidate Profile**
---------------------

* Execution-Focused: Operates with a bias towards action in a complex environment while keeping broader strategic goals in view
* Collaborative Leader: Builds trust and drives alignment across business, technology, and partner teams
* Structured Communicator: Able to synthesize information and clearly communicate at multiple levels
* Strategic Thinker: Comfortable working across ambiguity while maintaining focus on enterprise value creation
* Risk- and Control-Minded: Strong understanding of how to integrate risk frameworks into transformation programs
* Detail-Oriented & Disciplined: Brings rigor and structure to financial, operational, and programmatic tracking

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Program Execution & Governance**

* Drive the day-to-day execution of the Client Pathways transformation program roadmap, ensuring timely delivery of key milestones and outcomes.
* Partner with the SVP to run program governance, including creation of steering committee materials, executive dashboards, facilitation of program/workstream meetings, and coordination of senior leadership updates.
* Track progress and interdependencies across workstreams and proactively identify risks, blockers, or resource gaps.
* Ensure alignment across Technology, Investments, Middle office operations, Risk, Compliance, and Corporate teams.
* Co-lead overall program with the named Alpha Pathways lead, including workstream management, implementation strategy, execution, status and executive reporting, and issue management & escalation.
* Participate in business analysis as needed to understand the full complete ecosystem of enterprise Investment Book of Record (IBOR) and Accounting Book of Record (ABOR) systems, ensuring that the integration meets the specific needs and requirements of State Street IM team for comprehensive portfolio management, reconciliation, and near real-time reporting.

### **Stakeholder Management & Communication**

* Act as a liaison between IM and State Street affiliate teams (Global Delivery, Client Pathways, and GTS), supporting alignment on future-state service design and delivery expectations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across technology, operations, and functional leadership teams.
* Coordinate with Investments and COO leadership to ensure cross-functional needs are incorporated and addressed.
* Understand and drive clarity or priorities on the overall product and technology roadmap, ensuring alignment and clear communication

### **Operating Model & Service Oversight**

* Contribute to the development and implementation of the future-state operating model for outsourced front, middle and back-office services.
* Coordinate with colleagues to incorporate roles, processes, controls, and KPIs into existing governance programs
* Participate in vendor oversight processes, including service-level reviews, issue escalation, and performance tracking.

### **Risk Management & Controls**

* Ensure strong risk and control frameworks are embedded into transformed processes and platforms.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Corporate Audit to anticipate regulatory expectations and internal control standards.
* Support proactive identification and mitigation of risks tied to operating model shifts and service delivery transitions.

### **Financial Planning & Program Reporting**

* Coordinate with finance teams to track program budget and funding allocations across multiple State Street organizations.
* Support multi-year planning and scenario modeling to inform investment decisions and sequencing.
* Deliver accurate and transparent reporting on program financials, KPIs, and program health.
* Management and tracking of program resource costs and associated accounting treatment

### **Strategic Initiative Integration**

* Assist in sequencing broader strategic initiatives (e.g., data enablement, platform enhancements, organizational design) alongside the core transformation roadmap.
* Work closely with the COO Business Operations and CAO teams to align priorities and execution timelines.
* Ensure that critical business capabilities (multi-asset, alternatives, global operations) are considered in design decisions.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10 years of experience in financial services, with at least 8 years in program or transformation leadership roles within financial services
* Deep understanding of investment management operations and the front-to-back investment lifecycle of ABOR, IBOR and transaction management systems.
* Strong knowledge of risk and control frameworks, service-level oversight, and operational resiliency practices
* Demonstrated ability to drive complex, cross-functional programs with measurable business outcomes
*

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
At **Ocean Infinity**, we're on a bold mission to subsea data using innovative technology.

Using cutting-edge robotics, autonomous technology and world-class software, we're transforming how complex operations are carried out at sea. Our uncrewed systems are making ocean exploration and operations **safer, smarter and more sustainable**, helping unlock the vast potential of our oceans while reducing environmental impact.

This isn't a vision for the future. **It's happening right now.**

As we continue to push the boundaries of innovation and redefine what's possible in the maritime industry, we're looking for exceptional talent to join our fast-growing team.

Ocean Infinity is seeking a **Technical Program Manager** to sit within the Software Engineering organisation and own how software delivery runs across our most complex product and engineering programs. This is a senior, delivery-focused role with a strong technical footing. You are technically fluent enough to earn the trust of engineers, operate with a high degree of independence, and are trusted to define what good delivery looks like and hold teams and stakeholders to it.

You will report to the Director of Software Engineering, work closely with Product and senior leadership, partner directly with engineering managers and tech leads across the teams, and drive alignment across the IT, CyberSec, Data Platform, and Robotics & Autonomy organisations. The role suits someone who thrives in ambiguity, brings structure where there is none, and takes genuine ownership of outcomes

 **Requirements**

**What you will do!**

* Own and drive the delivery of the most complex, cross-team software programs against milestones, actively managing delivery against timelines and making trade-offs between time, quality and risk through each development cycle.
* Define what good delivery looks like across the organisation: set the standards, cadences and success criteria, not just track them.
* Keep delivery predictable. When timelines slip, diagnose the root cause and drive it to resolution rather than just reporting status.
* Work directly with engineering teams on ways of working, sprint health and delivery practices, surfacing risks and testing assumptions where complexity threatens delivery.
* Drive alignment and manage dependencies with the IT, CyberSec, Data Platform, and Robotics & Autonomy organisations, keeping cross-organisation work moving and unblocking delivery that depends on them.
* Drive the resolution of architecture and dependency decisions that block delivery, bringing the right senior engineers together to reach a clear call.
* Translate high-level business objectives into clear, meaningful plans that development teams can act on.
* Own the delivery of cross-team initiatives end to end, identifying dependencies, surfacing blockers early, and keeping programmes on track
* Coordinate planning cycles and periodic reviews with the Director of Software Engineering, and contribute to how the wider organisation plans and prioritises.
* Run capacity and resource planning across the teams: understand strengths, spot gaps, and help put the right people on the right work.
* Track and report on delivery and operational health to senior leadership, presenting risks, trade-offs and recommendations clearly and early.
* Partner with and mentor engineering managers and tech leads, strengthening delivery practices and ways of working across their teams.

**What we look for!**

* Significant experience in technical program or delivery management, including at senior or lead level, ideally within technology, engineering, or operationally complex environments.
* Strong technical fluency. You engage credibly with engineers on delivery, dependencies and technical trade-offs, and know when to pull in senior engineers for deep design calls.
* Proven track record owning large, complex, cross-functional programs end to end in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
* Strong at driving alignment and managing dependencies across separate organisations such as IT, security, data, and hardware or robotics teams.
* Experience working with and coaching engineering managers and tech leads on delivery and ways of working.
* Comfortable representing complex delivery trade-offs to senior leadership, clearly and concisely. Skilled at translating high-level objectives into meaningful work for development teams.
* Fluent with delivery tooling such as Jira, and able to self-manage your own tracking and reporting.
* Brings structure and clarity to complex problems without over-engineering or adding unnecessary process.

**Nice to have! ✨**

* Desirable Experience working within or alongside software engineering organisations.

**Benefits**

***\*Salary : £120,000 Per Annum\****

Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

To support our growth, we are looking for SOC Analysts to join our growing cyber security function. This role will be supporting our 24/7 operational capabilities (On-call rota, not shift based).

About Us

jobs.title: Project Manager, Healthcare

Medefer is a pioneer in virtual-first specialist healthcare. Founded by NHS consultants over a decade ago, we were delivering consultant-led virtual outpatient care well before “virtual hospitals” became a national priority. Our model has since been cited in government and NHS England material on the NHS Online vision as one of the service models informing this direction.

Help turn new healthcare partnerships into services that make a difference to patients.

We’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead delivery partner implementations and internal strategic projects. Reporting to the Director of Operations, you’ll work with NHS Trusts, independent providers and primary care organisations, taking projects from initial planning through to go-live and operational handover.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can manage several projects at once, bring people together and keep delivery moving.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own project delivery: lead partner implementations and internal projects, developing robust plans with clear timelines, milestones, dependencies and critical paths.
* Build strong partnerships: establish effective relationships with senior managers, clinicians and operational colleagues across partner organisations.
* Keep actions moving: influence internal and external stakeholders, resolve obstacles and escalate risks or delays when needed.
* Lead implementation meetings: chair meetings and facilitate workshops, deputising for the Director of Operations at the weekly internal Implementation Meeting.
* Manage plans in Asana: maintain accurate project plans, risk and issue logs, and act as the internal expert supporting consistent use of the platform.
* Oversee readiness for launch: coordinate partner configuration and deployment, ensuring user acceptance testing is completed before go-live.
* Coordinate service launches: align partners and internal teams around delivery dates, responsibilities and communications.
* Ensure effective handover: take operational accountability for new services during implementation and transfer ownership to the Service Delivery team once established.
* Provide clear reporting: communicate progress and give assurance to the Implementation Group and Senior Leadership Team.
* Improve future delivery: lead post-project evaluations, apply lessons learned and contribute to the clinical governance framework where required.

**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES:**

* At least five years’ experience in project & programme management.
* Substantial experience in operational healthcare delivery.
* A relevant project management qualification, such as PRINCE2 or Agile.
* A degree or equivalent experience.
* Experience developing and managing relationships with partner organisations.
* Confidence using project management tools to manage concurrent projects, dependencies, risks and deadlines.
* Excellent influencing and communication skills, including working effectively with senior managers and clinicians.
* A practical, organised approach and the confidence to take ownership of delivery.
* We’re looking for someone who is proactive, accountable and calm under pressure—comfortable challenging delays, adapting plans and working collaboratively to achieve results.
* Experience using Asana would be particularly valuable.

**WHY JOIN MEDEFER:**

You’ll join a supportive, collaborative team with the opportunity to influence how services develop as we grow. Our values—Patient First, Inventive and Collaborative—guide how we work.

We offer:

* Remote working.
* 28 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays.
* Private healthcare insurance and a workplace pension.
* Employee discounts and an Employee Assistance Programme.
* Wellbeing support, including access to GP and counselling services.
* Training, career development and opportunities for progression.

**WORKING ARRANGEMENTS AND KEY TERMS:**

This is a permanent position working 35 hours over five days per week, typically within 8am–5pm. You’ll need the right to work in the UK and a private, confidential workspace at home.

Appointment is subject to two satisfactory employment references, including your most recent employer, and a relevant DBS check funded by Medefer. Safeguarding is a core responsibility of the role.

Medefer is a Disability Confident Employer.

We commit to interviewing applicants who declare a disability and meet the **minimum essential criteria** for the job. If you would like to be considered under this scheme, please let us know in your application or by contacting our recruitment team.

Medefer fully complies with the Equality Act 201

jobs.title: Senior Treasury Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Trust unlocks our greatest potential.**

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

**What you can expect:**

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Treasury Operations team as a **Senior Treasury Operations Analyst?** Reporting to the Treasury Operations Lead, you will support Treasury Operations activities across ClearBank Group entities, including cash management, FX settlement, collateral and margin management and related processes. The role is responsible for executing complex operational activity with a high degree of accuracy and control, supporting day‑to‑day Treasury and contributing to the safe, resilient operation of a control‑critical function, while ensuring excellent service to internal and external stakeholders. As a senior member of the team, the role will deputise for the Treasury Operations Lead when required, providing operational leadership on shift, including coaching and direction to team members, while identifying efficiencies and continuous improvements across the function.

**Please note** - This role operates within a shift‑based Treasury Operations environment. Specific shift arrangements are communicated separately and may vary over time.

Your role includes:

* Execute Treasury Operations activities across multiple ClearBank Group entities and multi‑currency Nostro accounts, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and strong control discipline
* Perform and monitor FX settlement activity with multiple FX providers, resolving issues and exceptions within agreed procedures
* Support cash and liquidity management processes, working closely with Treasury to manage intraday and end‑of‑day balances
* Manage collateral and margin activity relating to UK securities, including transfers, settlement and ongoing monitoring of asset sales
* Ensure all Treasury and cash management instruments, including FX swaps and money market funds, are confirmed and settled without exceptions
* Deputise for the Treasury Operations Shift Manager when required, leading operational activity on shift and acting as a point of escalation within established BAU and contingency procedures
* Exercise sound judgement during live operational issues, escalating in a timely manner where there is a high degree of certainty that existing processes or controls may fail
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance Treasury Operations processes, controls and workflows
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams and, where required, external counterparties to support smooth operational delivery
* Produce operational reporting and management information as required to support oversight and decision‑making
* Support the onboarding and operation of new Treasury instruments and products as ClearBank Group’s offering evolves

**What you’ll bring:**

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

* Experience in Treasury Operations, cash management or payments operations within a regulated financial services environment
* Strong working knowledge of FX settlement, Nostro account management and liquidity processes
* Experience managing or supporting collateral and margin activity, including securities settlement
* Proven ability to operate effectively in a time‑critical or shift‑based environment
* Sound understanding of operational risk, controls and escalation frameworks
* Experience producing or contributing to operational reporting and MI
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work confidently across teams and with external parties

Beneficial skills:

* Experience supporting multiple legal entities and currencies
* Exposure to new product or instrument launches within Treasury or Operations
* Knowledge of UK securities settlement processes and market infrastructure
* Experience contributing to process improvement or operational change initiatives

Regretfully we are not able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes at the current time.

* You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;
* You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;
* You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;
* ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

* We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

* Exposure to settlement monitoring, exposure management and reconciliation processes
* Experience working within investment banks, custodians or securities finance providers

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please use the designated space within the application questionnaire.

This is a FTC/Contract position located in London with hybrid working. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks. For this role, a valid working permit for the UK is mandatory.

* Consulting & Solutions
* Technology

jobs.title: Senior IT Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Synthomer is a leading supplier of high-performance, highly specialised polymers and ingredients that play vital roles in key sectors such as coatings, construction, adhesives, and health and protection – growing markets that serve billions of end users worldwide. Headquartered in London, UK and publicly listed there since 1971, we employ c.3,900 employees across our 5 innovation centres of excellence and more than 29 manufacturing sites across Europe, North America and Asia. Around 20% of our sales volumes are from new and patent protected products.

At our innovation centres of excellence in the UK, Germany, China, Malaysia and Ohio, USA we collaborate closely with our customers to develop new products and enhance existing ones tailored to their needs, with an increasing range of sustainability benefits. Since 2021, we have been proud holders of the London Stock Exchange Green Economy Mark, which recognises green technology businesses making a significant contribution to a more sustainable, low-carbon economy.

Are you passionate about cyber security and ready to make a real impact in a global organisation? At **Synthomer**, we're looking for a **Senior IT Security Analyst** to help strengthen and evolve our security capabilities across our international business.

This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of critical security platforms, investigate threats, drive continuous improvement, and play a key role in protecting our people, systems and data.

**What You'll Be Doing**

As a Senior IT Security Analyst, you'll be at the heart of our security operations, working across a range of technologies and initiatives, including:

✅ Managing and improving our security platforms and services

✅ Administering key technologies including **Microsoft 365 Security, Purview, Mimecast, Trellix, Defender and Skyhigh SWG**

✅ Investigating phishing attempts, security incidents and emerging cyber threats

✅ Supporting cloud security, data protection and DLP initiatives

✅ Acting as a trusted security partner to IT teams, external providers and business stakeholders

✅ Driving security awareness and promoting best practice across the organisation

✅ Contributing to security projects, audits and continuous improvement programmes

**What We're Looking For**

We're interested in security professionals who combine strong technical expertise with a proactive, customer-focused mindset.

You'll ideally have:

* Experience in an IT Security, Cyber Security or Information Security role
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Security technologies
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, DLP, Information Protection and Compliance tools
* Experience administering Mimecast or similar email security platforms
* Experience with endpoint protection and secure web gateway technologies
* Understanding of Azure security controls and cloud security principles
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills
* A passion for staying ahead of the evolving threat landscape

**Why Join Synthomer?**

At Synthomer, security is a business priority. You'll have the opportunity to work with modern security technologies, partner with international teams, and help shape the future of cyber security across a global organisation.

If you're looking for a role where you can take ownership, broaden your expertise, and make a tangible difference every day, we'd love to hear from you.

* **Competitive,** market-aligned compensation
* **Discretionary** global bonus scheme
* **Discretionary** Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) – for senior positions
* **Company** car or car allowance – varies by region and role
* **Healthcare** – tailored to regional locations
* **Parental leave and family support** – maternity, paternity, adoption (aligned with regional policies)
* **Working options** – flexibility where it matters, based on role and business needs

* **Learning & development opportunities** – training, online platforms, buddy/mentorship programs, Internal Synthomer University with L&D offers
* **Wellbeing support** – employee assistance program (EAP), mental health resources, wellbeing initiatives
* **Retirement / pension contributions** – plans vary by country
* **Culture of Inclusion** – where everyone can thrive
* **Performance culture,** global reward & recognition programmes

### **Programme Description**

**What does this team do?**

This role sits within the Finance Transformation Consulting persona. For a reminder, please follow the link to the website: Early Careers Consulting | Deloitte UK.

Deloitte's Finance Transformation team supports Chief Financial Officers, guiding them through complex challenges to help them improve their businesses. As a part of Deloitte's Finance Transformation offering, we empower finance functions with cutting-edge tools and insights, using cloud-based solutions to navigate today's business complexities.

Our expertise spans the entire transformation journey, from collaborating with businesses to developing and refining their strategy, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.

Our service offerings are structured to deliver comprehensive support: we partner with CFOs to develop their vision and anticipate future market and business demands. We used advanced analytics and other forms of tech to help our clients achieve their goals in performance management, budgeting and all other areas.

Beyond financial performance, we are committed to using tech to create positive and empowering experiences for finance professionals, championing sustainability, diversity, and inclusion. We are passionate about making a difference for our clients, their employees, and society as a whole.

**Business Finance & Controllership**

Support clients in enhancing financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytics capabilities through the implementation of modern finance processes, scalable data platforms, and AI-enabled solutions. Drive improvements across finance operations, reporting, and treasury functions to enable better decision-making, efficiency, and long-term business performance.

**Finance Strategy**

Help organisations define and execute finance transformation strategies that align finance capabilities with evolving business and technology priorities. Partner with stakeholders to design future-ready finance functions, delivering efficient, value-driven outcomes that support strategic business objectives.

**Global Business Services (GBS)**

Design and optimise shared services and operating models across functions including Finance, HR, IT, and Supply Chain to improve efficiency, agility, and cost effectiveness. Enable organisations to enhance customer and employee experiences while driving sustainable value through technology-enabled transformation and predictive insights.

**What skills and academic qualifications do I need?**

This programme is for university students who are doing well academically and want to test their skills in the real world. You must be in the penultimate year of your course, or going onto a Masters, and you need to be on track to achieve a predicted degree classification of 2:1 or above in any discipline.

Duration of the programme: 6-weeks

We have identified 10 core skills that are essential to all our roles in Early Careers. To learn more about these skills and their detailed descriptions, please visit the 'Discover What We Look For' section in our Candidate Zone.

**What kind of work will I do?**

As an intern in Finance Transformation, some of your tasks might include:

* Getting to the bottom of client’s problems through interactive workshops and labs.
* Working with people from our clients’ business and IT teams to understand what our clients’ problems and needs are supporting the design and implementation of new solutions across finance.
* Creating documents that are crucial to the delivery and execution of the programme, alongside materials presented back to clients.
* Learning how to engage with clients to solve their most complex problems and the approaches Deloitte takes to understand their needs.
* Discovering how technologies support everything an organisation does, and which technologies work best for each part of a business.

Through this immersive experience, you'll develop a deep understanding of client engagement strategies, master the art of problem-solving, and gain exposure to the power of technology in shaping modern businesses. You'll work with experts across Deloitte's Finance Transformation and wider practice, gaining invaluable insights into how we leverage our diverse expertise to deliver exceptional client service to the world's leading organisations.

**Where will I work?**

At Deloitte we recognise how important face-to-face interaction is for your development in a new role. We also understand that our people need flexibility, which is why we operate a hybrid system, with a combination of office and home working. If you’re in a client-facing role, you might be expected to attend client sites on certain days, while your meetings will be a mix of online and in-person events. Please note your final assessment and induction will also be in-person, to give you the opportunity to network and build relationships.

**All our workspaces are accessible, however, if you require further flexibility due to a health condition or caring responsibilities, please discuss this with our team. You can find further information on our** **family friendly, flexible working here.**

**How will I develop?**

The Summer Vacation Scheme in Finance Transformation will help you learn:

* What technologies organisations currently use and how they can transform those to improve their businesses and meet objectives.
* How to support and interpret business strategies and objectives and transform those into requirements and solutions.
* What large-scale technology transformations look like.
* How to build rapport with clients and ensure they have confidence in your capability.

You will have unrivalled access to the largest and most important organisations in the world, as well as world class experts within Deloitte, all of which allow you to truly build a solid foundation for any career you seek

**OBJECTIVES OF THE PROGRAMME**
-------------------------------

The strategic objective of the Department of Polio Eradication Initiative is to achieve certification of the eradication of polioviruses worldwide by providing support to national governments via the Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) Partnership. The two goals of the current GPEI Strategy are to permanently interrupt transmission of all polioviruses in endemic countries and to stop vaccine-derived poliovirus transmission and prevent outbreaks in non-endemic countries. The five objectives within the GPEI Strategy are to create urgency and accountability to generate greater political will, generate vaccine acceptance through context-adapted community engagement, expedite progress through expanded integration efforts with broader partners, improve frontline success through evaluating and adapting campaign operations and outbreak response, and enhance detection and response through sensitive surveillance activities. Additionally, the strategy includes implementing the four objectives in the GPEI Gender Equality Strategy for Polio Eradication. The immediate strategic objective is to achieve and sustain polio-free status in all regions, thereby eliminating the disease and preventing its resurgence. The Polio Data and Information Systems (DIS) team is responsible for the management, organization, analysis and dissemination of polio related data including immunization data, program monitoring and poliovirus surveillance information while promoting and maintaining global polio information systems such as Polio Information System (POLIS), WebIFA and geodatabases.

* At least 5 years' experience in health information systems, statistical analysis, and data management services.

* Experience in data analysis of communicable diseases and/or vaccinepreventable diseases.

jobs.description:
LOGISTICS & BUSINESS ANALYST

Location: Dubai, UAE

Department: Logistics / Operations / Business Development

Reports To: General Manager / Operations Director

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose:

The Logistics & Business Analyst will analyze logistics operations, transportation activities, costs, shipments, warehouse performance, customer requirements, and business data to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, increase profitability, and support management decision-making.

The candidate will work closely with the Operations, Finance, Sales, Warehouse, Procurement, and Customer Service teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Logistics & Operations Analysis

\* Monitor daily shipment and delivery performance.

\* Analyze delivery schedules, delays, vehicle utilization, and route efficiency.

\* Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions.

\* Monitor transportation and warehouse productivity.

\* Analyze fleet, driver, shipment, and delivery performance.

\* Track order-to-delivery cycle times.

2. Cost & Profitability Analysis

\* Analyze transportation, fuel, warehouse, manpower, and handling costs.

\* Calculate cost per shipment, delivery, kilometer, vehicle, and customer.

\* Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary logistics expenses.

\* Analyze customer and route profitability.

\* Prepare monthly logistics cost and profitability reports.

3. Business Intelligence & Reporting

\* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly management reports.

\* Develop dashboards using Microsoft Excel and Power BI.

\* Analyze trends, performance, and operational KPIs.

\* Present key findings and recommendations to management.

\* Maintain accurate databases and operational records.

4. Supply Chain Analysis

\* Monitor inventory movement and stock levels.

\* Analyze demand and supply requirements.

\* Identify slow-moving and fast-moving products.

\* Support warehouse and distribution planning.

\* Analyze supplier and customer performance.

5. Business Development Support

\* Analyze potential customers, markets, routes, and distribution opportunities.

\* Prepare business cases and financial projections.

\* Evaluate new logistics contracts and customer requirements.

\* Support management in pricing and commercial decisions.

\* Analyze competitor pricing and market trends.

Key Performance Indicators — KPIs

The Analyst will be measured on:

\* Reduction in logistics operating costs

\* Improvement in on-time delivery percentage

\* Reduction in delivery delays

\* Improvement in vehicle utilization

\* Reduction in empty trips

\* Improvement in warehouse productivity

\* Accuracy of management reports

\* Reduction in cost per shipment

\* Improvement in customer profitability

\* Accuracy of forecasting and operational analysis

\* Timely delivery of management reports

Required Qualifications

\* Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field.

\* 2–5 years of relevant experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, distribution, or business analysis.

\* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, charts, and data analysis.

\* Experience with Power BI is highly preferred.

\* Knowledge of ERP/WMS/TMS systems is an advantage.

\* Strong numerical and analytical abilities.

\* Excellent communication and reporting skills.

\* Ability to work with large datasets and identify meaningful business insights.

\* UAE logistics experience is preferred.

Preferred Experience

Experience in any of the following sectors will be an advantage:

\* FMCG distribution

\* E-commerce logistics

\* Warehousing

\* Last-mile delivery

\* Freight forwarding

\* Transportation

\* Retail distribution

\* Food & beverage distribution

\* Import/export logistics

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should not only prepare reports but also be able to answer:

“What is happening, why is it happening, what is it costing us, and what should management do about it?”

The candidate must be commercially minded, highly analytical, detail-oriented, and capable of converting operational data into practical business decisions.

Salary & Benefits

Depending on experience and technical skills.

For a stronger candidate with advanced Power BI, SQL, ERP/TMS experience and logistics-sector expertise, a higher package can be considered.

Benefits may include:

\* Employment visa

\* Medical insurance

\* Annual leave

\* Annual air ticket, subject to company policy

\* Performance-based incentive/bonus

\* Other company benefits according to UAE employment regulations

Reporting Structure

Logistics & Business Analyst

↓

Operations Manager / General Manager

↓

Management / CEO

First 90-Day Objectives

First 30 days: Understand the company’s logistics operations, systems, customers, routes, costs, and existing KPIs.

Days 31–60: Establish accurate reporting, identify major operational inefficiencies, and develop initial dashboards.

Days 61–90: Present cost-saving opportunities, route/vehicle optimization recommendations, customer profitability analysis, and an improved KPI reporting system.

jobs.title: Field Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Why qlub**

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

**The role**

qlub is scaling rapidly across the US, and we're looking for a **Field Implementation Manager** to own the successful launch of new restaurant partners across the market.

This is a **field-based role**. You'll spend most of your time **on-site with restaurant partners**, taking venues from signed agreements to fully live and operational. You'll coordinate implementation activities, configure and deploy qlub's solutions, train restaurant teams, troubleshoot issues, and ensure every launch meets our operational and customer experience standards.

You'll work closely with Sales, Operations, Product, and Technical teams to remove implementation blockers and deliver a seamless launch experience. This role requires someone who is highly hands-on, commercially aware, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving environment.

If you enjoy being in the field, solving problems in real time, and taking ownership from **"signed" to "live,"** this role is for you.

**What you’ll own**

* Own end-to-end venue implementations, from handover after contract signature through launch and stabilization
* Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Product, and Technical teams to ensure every implementation is delivered on time and to a high standard
* Conduct on-site venue visits to assess operational requirements, configure solutions, deploy hardware/software, and prepare restaurants for launch
* Lead hands-on training and enablement for restaurant owners, managers, and front-of-house teams to ensure they are confident using qlub
* Troubleshoot implementation and operational issues on-site, working with internal teams to drive issues through to resolution
* Manage multiple venue launches simultaneously, prioritizing activities based on launch timelines, venue requirements, and business impact
* Ensure all implementation requirements, configurations, and launch milestones are accurately documented and completed
* Monitor newly launched venues during the initial stabilization period, identifying adoption or operational issues and proactively addressing them
* Build strong relationships with restaurant partners and act as the primary implementation point of contact throughout the launch process
* Identify recurring implementation challenges and work with internal teams to improve processes, tools, and the overall launch playbook
* Provide feedback from the field to Product and Operations to help improve qlub's solutions and merchant experience
* Maintain high implementation velocity while ensuring quality, accuracy, and an excellent partner experience

**Who you are**

* You've done this before in a fast-moving, high-growth environment
* You move fast and make strong decisions with incomplete information
* You take real ownership and think like an operator, not a coordinator
* You're energized by hard problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience

**What you’ll need**

* 3+ years of experience in Implementation, Customer Success, Field Operations, Account Management, Onboarding, or a similar customer-facing operational role
* Proven experience managing end-to-end implementations, launches, or deployments across multiple customers or locations
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders and coordinating projects against tight deadlines
* Exceptional in-person and written communication skills, with the ability to build trust quickly with customers and internal teams
* Strong problem-solving and project management skills with excellent attention to detail
* Comfortable working independently and managing your own schedule across a large geographic territory
* Valid US driver's license and access to reliable transportation
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned market and spend the majority of your time on-site with restaurant partners
* Fluency in English is a must

**Nice to have**

* Experience implementing hardware, SaaS, POS, payment, or other technology solutions
* Experience working with multi-location restaurant groups or enterprise customers
* Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment

**What we offer**

* Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
* The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
* A fast-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
* Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
* A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest-growing restaurant technology companies globally

**Ready to build?** Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

**Title**

Revenue Operations Analyst

**Team**

Revenue Operations

**Location**

This is a hybrid role based in Santa Monica, California. We're currently working from a temporary office space, with 2 to 3 days a week onsite

**About Jitsu**

Jitsu is a last-mile delivery service that allows brands to give their customers a consistent delivery experience all the way to the doorstep. Using a proprietary AI-powered technology platform, Jitsu helps its customers deliver on their promise of affordable, reliable, expedited shipping with a 99+% on-time delivery rate. Logistics teams can now provide a differentiated delivery experience at a competitive cost through successful first delivery attempts, fewer claims, coverage in the markets that matter, and upfront pricing with no hidden surcharges. Jitsu operates in urban areas across the U.S., enabling high-volume shippers to exercise control over their end-to-end delivery network. Learn more at gojitsu.com

**About the Role**
------------------

Jitsu is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to bring additional visibility, accuracy, and accountability to our go-to-market engine. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, you'll own a portfolio of analytics and reporting that directly informs how leadership manages pipeline, forecast, customer health, and sales compensation.

The role is built to scale with the right person. You'll start by owning core analytics and research deliverables, with the potential to take on leadership roles spearheading quality initiatives and setting reporting standards across the business. Executive exposure is high. You'll be presenting your analysis directly to executive leadership in the forums where pipeline, forecast, and customer health decisions get made.

--------------------------

* 2–4 years in revenue operations, sales operations, finance, consulting, business analytics, or a closely related analytical role.

You will work alongside the Data team at VINCI Airports headquarters, the Commercial Performance Manager, and commercial teams at our airports.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Spacecraft Harnessing
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

Muon seeks a Spacecraft Harnessing Technical Program Manager to lead the end-to-end planning, procurement, manufacturing, acceptance testing, and delivery of prototype, test, and flight cable assemblies and interconnect systems for our next-generation satellite constellations. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of electrical engineering, mechanical integration, high-reliability manufacturing, and Assembly, Integration, and Test (AI&T).

The Harnessing TPM will serve as the primary operational owner for transforming harness schematics and mechanical routing designs into fully tested, flight-ready interconnect networks. The role spans detailed hardware release planning, supply chain coordination, testing execution, and fleet-scale delivery across multiple concurrent spacecraft builds and test environments.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Please note: This role will need full time on-site (5x/week) for the first six months for a ramp up period and then can transition to hybrid schedule (3x/week).

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Hardware Delivery**
  + Spacecraft Harness Delivery: Own the end-to-end planning and execution of all spacecraft harnessing needs entering AI&T, delivering complete, fully tested, and flight-ready interconnect assemblies for vehicle integration.
  + Testbed Fleet Support: Deliver complete, validated harnessing systems to Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) testbeds to support ongoing Flight Software (FSW) development, verification, and mission simulations for each satellite mission.
  + Future Mission Planning: Support engineering teams by planning harness architecture development for future constellation blocks and driving cross-functional execution across design, procurement, fabrication, and testing.
* **Program Execution & Reporting**
  + Cross-Functional Execution: Drive end-to-end program alignment across electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, supply chain, and vehicle AI&T teams to meet critical assembly and integration milestones.
  + Program Metrics & Reporting: Track, analyze, and report key harnessing program metrics—including schedule status, resource allocation, risk posture, technical performance, and cost variance.
* **Supply Chain & Risk Management**
  + Procurement & Production Tracking: Track the procurement, fabrication, and assembly status for all custom wire harnesses, specialized connectors, contacts, backshells, and associated mechanical shielding.
  + Issue Resolution: Proactively identify, track, and drive resolution for supply chain bottlenecks, component lead time spikes, design changes, and manufacturing or testing fallouts.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 3+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, or hardware production management delivering complex electromechanical assemblies, cable harnesses, or aerospace hardware.
* Hands-on technical background in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or wire harness manufacturing and testing.
* Proven track record managing harness production lifecycles—from initial routing schematics and pinout definition through procurement, wire assembly, continuity/hipot testing, and acceptance.
* Demonstrated experience managing programs with a complex, multi-tiered, critical-path supply chain.
* Familiarity with program management scheduling and tracking tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
* U.S. Citizenship required (program is ITAR-restricted).

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Direct experience in satellite or aerospace AI&T, vehicle interconnect manufacturing, or satellite constellation volume production.
* Working knowledge of space-grade wiring and crimping standards (e.g., NASA-STD-8739.4, IPC/WHMA-A-620 Space Addendum).
* Familiarity with hardware/software integration environments, testbeds, or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) simulators used for flight software development.
* Experience managing environmental and electrical acceptance testing campaigns for cabling (e.g., high-potential testing, continuity verification, outgassing considerations, mass properties).
* Proficiency with ERP/PLM and tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Arena, Agile PLM, SAP, or similar toolsets).
* PMP certification or equivalent program management credentials.
* Experience with harness and/or mechanical CAD software (such as RapidHarness, Solidworks, etc).

**Salary**
----------

The salary range for this role is $174,000 - $199,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

**About Muon Space**
--------------------

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

---------------------------

In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

### **About the role**

The Security Risk team is responsible for how Anthropic identifies, prioritizes, and drives treatment of its most important security risks. We are rebuilding risk management to operate as an engineering function, using automation, quantitative risk and AI-native platforms to enable decision making. The risks we assess span Anthropic's full security landscape, so the team needs breadth across domains and the judgment to go deep wherever a decision demands it. Security Risk, in deep partnership with Security Engineering, helps define the security program and shapes how investment and treatment decisions get made.

The conventional GRC playbook was not built for a company shipping frontier AI. You will help define what replaces it, with a direct line to CISO-level decisions. As a Security Risk Analyst you will take risk questions from leadership and partner teams and drive them to a decision. Sometimes that is a fast, structured qualitative assessment and other times it is a deep FAIR-based quantitative analysis. Either way you bring leadership a clear position, the tradeoffs, and honest uncertainty, and you defend it under challenge. In parallel, you will help turn quantitative risk into a product partner teams can leverage, and define the standards a growing risk function will run on.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Enable leadership and partner teams to make risk-informed decisions. Take ambiguous risk questions, drive them to a documented decision, and communicate the quantitative and qualitative tradeoffs clearly
* Lead quantitative analysis of the company's top security risk scenarios using FAIR, calibrated estimation, and simulation, working with the engineers who own the systems and presenting results in terms leadership can act on
* Partner with Security Engineering to assess threat scenarios and control effectiveness so security investment is right-sized to actual risk and remediation is sequenced where it buys down the most risk
* Frame escalations and risk treatment decisions with a clear recommendation, an honest statement of uncertainty, and re-evaluation triggers, and pressure test those decisions with risk owners
* Shape the analysis and narrative behind leadership risk reviews, and help define risk appetite and the risk metrics the organization should measure and why
* Use AI and automation to scale risk analysis, and own the calibration and quality review that keep the outputs trustworthy
* Turn one-off analyses into reusable methods, templates, and training so risk analysis becomes increasingly self service for partner teams, and raise the analytical quality of the risk register

### **You may be a good fit if you**

* Have owned security or technology risk analysis end to end, qualitative and quantitative, and can point to a decision your output changed, whether a funding call, a launch call, a remediation sequence, or a documented acceptance
* Have hands-on FAIR-style quantification experience, including scenario decomposition, calibrated estimation, and Monte Carlo simulation in Python, R, or spreadsheet tooling, briefed to decision makers
* Thrive in ambiguity. You frame a moving question into something analyzable, pick the depth that fits, and drive to a decision rather than a report
* Put defensible severity and likelihood on ambiguous problems, state uncertainty honestly, and change your position when the evidence changes
* Have enough technical security depth to decompose an attack path with security engineers and be credible in the room
* Can compress a complex risk position into one paragraph for the CISO, make the tradeoff explicit, and defend it under pointed questions
* Use Claude or other LLMs as daily working tools and review model output critically
* Are low ego and collaborative, build credibility through the work, and care about AI safety and the role security risk plays in it

### **Strong candidates may also**

* Have applied FAIR-CAM or another structured approach to control effectiveness and attack path modeling
* Have built or operated a cyber risk quantification program, or turned quantitative analysis into tooling, templates, or training that others ran
* Have helped define risk appetite or tolerance thresholds an organization actually used to make decisions
* Bring a background in security engineering, detection, threat intelligence, actuarial science, or decision science that grounds the numbers in real systems
* Are familiar with security risks specific to AI systems, such as goal or intent modification, and how they change traditional threat models

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity's reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

**Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)**

The Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) is responsible for leading the development, implementation, and oversight of Risk Management Framework (RMF), Information Security, and information assurance programs supporting classified and unclassified systems across collateral and Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) environments. This role ensures compliance with 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM) and applicable Intelligence Community Directives (ICDs), safeguarding national security information while enabling mission success.

The ISSM serves as the principal advisor on all classified information system security matters and collaborates closely with government customers, security leadership, and technical teams to maintain secure, compliant, and inspection-ready environments.

Working in coordination with the Chief Security Officer, the ISSM implements enterprise common controls and represents the organization with U.S. Government accrediting authorities, including Authorizing Officials (AOs) and Security Control Assessors (SCAs). The ISSM ensures a strong operational security posture across local area networks (LANs), wide area networks (WANs), and standalone systems through proactive risk management and continuous monitoring.

**Role**

* **Program Leadership, Compliance & RMF**

  + Lead and manage the Information System Security Program in accordance with NISPOM and applicable ICDs (e.g., ICD 503, ICD 705).
  + Serve as principal advisor on all classified systems security matters.
  + Oversee RMF lifecycle activities, including system categorization, control implementation, assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring.
  + Ensure systems meet classified processing requirements and maintain proper accreditation status.
  + Develop, review, and maintain System Security Plans (SSPs), policies, procedures (SPPs), and supporting artifacts.
  + Represent the organization with accrediting authorities; review and approve authorization packages.
  + Interface directly with Security Control Assessors (SCAs) to demonstrate compliance during assessments.

  **System Security & Continuous Monitoring**

  + Manage continuous monitoring programs, including vulnerability assessments, POA&M tracking, and audit reviews.
  + Analyze SIEM outputs and audit logs to identify anomalous or unauthorized activity.
  + Conduct self-assessments and implement corrective actions to address vulnerabilities and compliance gaps.
  + Maintain accurate system documentation, including SSPs, POA&Ms, and risk assessment reports.
  + Ensure configuration management, patching, and system hardening in alignment with STIG requirements.

  **Network, Operations & Incident Response**

  + Oversee the cybersecurity posture of LANs, WANs, and standalone systems.
  + Monitor systems to detect threats, vulnerabilities, and operational risks.
  + Manage COMSEC, media control, and data spill response procedures across classified environments.
  + Develop and execute incident response processes for spills, malware, and insider threat activities.
  + Investigate, document, and report incidents in accordance with government requirements.
  + Assess the security impact of system changes and support formal change management processes.

  **Inspections, Training & Governance**

  + Lead and support inspections, audits, and assessments conducted by DCSA and Intelligence Community stakeholders.
  + Engage directly with government representatives to validate compliance with technical and policy requirements.
  + Review and implement security advisories, directives, and emerging requirements.
  + Deliver security education and awareness training to users, administrators, and leadership.
  + Develop and enforce classified system policies, procedures, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  + Communicate security responsibilities clearly across all organizational levels.

**Requirements**

* Active U.S. Government Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in ISSM roles supporting classified systems in collateral and SCIF environments.
* Demonstrated experience with eMASS and participation in DCSA assessments.
* Current CompTIA Security+ (or equivalent) certification in compliance with DoD Directive 8140.
* Strong expertise in RMF and working knowledge of NISPOM, ICD 503, ICD 705, and NIST standards.
* Experience with vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., ACAS), SIEM platforms, and STIG implementation across Windows and Linux systems.
* Proven leadership, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Preferred certifications: CISSP, CISM, or CAP.

**U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required**

(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
**Hi! We're Forerunner.**
=========================

Stronger, more resilient communities are built by the people inside government and regulated industries who keep critical infrastructure running. But they're working against real headwinds: fragmented data, field crews without the right tools, and high-stakes decisions made without a complete picture.

Forerunner exists to fix that. We build intelligent software that connects the systems these agencies and firms already rely on, fills the gaps those systems can't, and turns fragmented information into decisions and actions that reduce liability, surface revenue, and prevent small problems from becoming emergencies.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Deployment Specialist, you will own the end-to-end deployment experience for our customers — from discovery to go-live — ensuring the outcome aligns with business impact. You’ll act at the intersection of strategy, project management, and operational delivery, collaborating with customers, internal teams, and technical resources to make deployments high-quality, repeatable, and outcome-driven.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Customer Discovery & Planning**

* Lead structured workshops with customers to uncover business objectives, operational constraints, and success metrics.
* Translate findings into a clear deployment roadmap and set of deliverables.
* Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and governance.

### **Project Leadership**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer during deployment.
* Coordinate across cross-functional teams (Forward Deployed Engineer, Customer Success Manager, other internal stakeholders) to ensure alignment and momentum.
* Proactively identify risks, manage dependencies, and escalate when necessary.
* Provide regular status updates to both the customer and internal leadership.

### **Solution Design & Oversight**

* Using both the product front-end and Forerunner MCP, configure client systems and ensure system design stays aligned with business goals.
* Work with the Forward Deployed Engineer to scope integrations and customizations.
* Ensure that deployment deliverables map back to the business requirements and success criteria.

### **Customer Enablement & Handoff**

* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) and drive readiness for go-live.
* Collaborate with the Customer Success Manager to ensure a smooth transition to the ongoing success phase.
* Document lessons learned, refine the playbook, and drive continuous improvement across deployments.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4-6 years of experience in project management, SaaS implementation delivery, customer consulting, and operations. Experience with GIS or construction project management is a plus.
* Strong ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured, executable plans.
* Excellent communication skills with both technical and executive stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment where you are building repeatable processes

### **You’ll thrive in this role if you…**

* Believe in delivering measurable outcomes to customers, not just checking off tasks.
* Enjoy being the glue across teams, driving clarity, and removing friction.
* Are comfortable juggling strategic thinking and tactical execution.
* Want to build and refine playbooks that scale, not just follow them.

**Our team has a lot to offer.**
--------------------------------

Forerunner is an early stage company with an interdisciplinary team. We are motivated by seemingly intractable problems and work hard to support one another.

* **We're mission-driven.** Our mission orients our business strategy and pushes us to work with a sense of urgency. We’re in the weeds - our entire team spends time engaging with our partners in the field to better understand the real-world problems they face.
* **We're a small team.** As a member of our growing team, you will quickly become an invaluable part of our organization and have a meaningful impact on our business and technical direction. We welcome unique perspectives and backgrounds. Your opinion matters and we hope you'll share it.
* **We value in-person collaboration**. Some of our best work happens when we're solving problems together in the same room, so this role is hybrid and based near one of our offices: New York City, San Francisco, or Portland, Maine.
* **We want you to be happy and healthy.** Forerunner offers competitive compensation, health/vision/dental coverage, and commuter benefits. We also have a quarterly wellness reimbursement so that you can have flexibility in defining what “health” means to you.

The salary range for this position is 120,000-165,000. This posting may span more than one career level. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including an individual's skills, experience, and qualifications.

Forerunner is an equal opportunity employer committed to embracing diversity and the perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required; Business Analytics, Statistics, Supply Chain, Economics, Information Systems, or related field preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in business analytics, operations analytics, customer service analytics, ecommerce analytics, or related fields.
* Experience building dashboards, scorecards, and executive-level reporting.
* Strong experience analyzing operational, customer, and commercial performance data.
* Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into reporting and analytical solutions.
* Experience managing large datasets and working with multiple data sources.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting DTC or Ecommerce business models.
* Experience analyzing customer service performance metrics and consumer behavior.
* Experience with inventory management, fulfillment, or supply chain reporting.
* Experience developing executive dashboards and KPI frameworks.
* Experience supporting customer experience improvement initiatives through analytics.
* Experience working with data visualization and business intelligence platforms.
